Filesystem Fallback (Planner)\n859\t\n860\t**Triggered when:** Agent() returns but the return contains no recognized marker (`## PLANNING COMPLETE`, `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, `## ⚠ Source Audit`, `## CHECKPOINT REACHED`, `## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE`).\n861\t\n862\t```bash\n863\t# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n864\t# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n865\t# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n866\t# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n867\t# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\n868\tDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n869\t```\n870\t\n871\t**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** The planner wrote plans to disk but the Agent() return was empty or\n872\ttruncated (the Windows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never\n873\tarrived). Display:\n874\t\n875\t```text\n876\t◆ Planner wrote {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) to disk but did not emit a PLANNING COMPLETE marker.\n877\t  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — work is likely recoverable.\n878\t\n879\t  Plans found on disk:\n880\t  {ls output of *-PLAN.md}\n881\t```\n882\t\n883\tOffer 3 options:\n884\t1. **Accept plans** — treat as `## PLANNING COMPLETE` and continue through step 9 `## PLANNING COMPLETE` handling (so `--skip-verify` / `plan_checker_enabled=false` are honored — may skip to step 13 rather than step 10)\n885\t2. **Retry planner** — re-spawn the planner with the same prompt (return to step 8)\n886\t3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n887\t\n888\t**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0 and no marker:** The planner produced no output. Treat as\n889\t`## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE` and handle accordingly.\n890\t\n891\t## 9b. Handle Phase Split Recommendation\n892\t\n893\tWhen the planner returns `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, it means the phase's source items exceed the context budget for full-fidelity implementation. (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n960\t```\n961\t\n962\tChecker prompt:\n963\t\n964\t```markdown\n965\t<verification_context>\n966\t**Phase:** {phase_number}\n967\t**Phase Goal:** {goal from ROADMAP}\n968\t**Mode:** {standard | gap_closure | reviews}\n969\t\n970\t<required_reading>\n971\t- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Plans to verify)\n972\t- {roadmap_path} (Roadmap)\n973\t- {requirements_path} (Requirements)\n974\t- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n975\t- {research_path} (Technical Research — includes Validation Architecture)\n976\t- {reviews_path} (Cross-AI Review Feedback - if --reviews; verify actionable findings are represented in PLAN.md)\n977\t</required_reading>\n978\t\n979\t${AGENT_SKILLS_CHECKER}\n980\t\n981\t<review_incorporation_verification>\n982\t**If Mode is reviews:** Read REVIEWS.md and verify each current actionable review finding is visible in executable PLAN.md content or explicitly deferred/rejected in the relevant PLAN.md. Use WARNING by default; use BLOCKER when the missing incorporation can prevent the phase goal, create unsafe execution, or invalidate verification.\n985\t</review_incorporation_verification>\n986\t\n987\t**Phase requirement IDs (MUST ALL be covered):** {phase_req_ids}\n988\t\n989\t**Project instructions:** Read ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md if either exists — verify plans honor project guidelines\n990\t**Project skills:** Check .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/ directory (if either exists) — verify plans account for project skill rules\n991\t</verification_context>\n992\t\n993\t<expected_output>\n994\t- ## VERIFICATION PASSED — all checks pass\n995\t- ## ISSUES FOUND — structured issue list\n996\t</expected_output>\n997\t```\n998\t\n999\t```\n1000\tAgent(\n1001\t  prompt=checker_prompt,\n1002\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-plan-checker\",\n1003\t  model=\"{checker_model}\",\n1004\t  description=\"Verify Phase {phase} plans\",\n1005\t  run_in_background=true\n1006\t)\n1007\t```\n1008\t\n1009\t**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `CHECKER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md' \"## VERIFICATION PASSED\" \"## ISSUES FOUND\")` while waiting/active.\n1010\t\n1011\t## 11. Handle Checker Return\n1012\t\n1013\t- **`marker_received` + `## VERIFICATION PASSED`:** Display confirmation, proceed to step 13.\n1014\t- **`marker_received` + `## ISSUES FOUND`:** Display issues, check iteration count, proceed to step 12.\n1015\t- **`stalled`:** Automatically surface 11a's recovery choice (Accept verification / Retry checker / Stop) — no manual interrupt needed.\n1016\t- **Empty / truncated / no recognized marker:** → Filesystem fallback (step 11a).\n1017\t\n1018\t**Thinking partner for architectural tradeoffs (conditional):**\n1019\tIf `features.thinking_partner` is enabled, scan the checker's issues for architectural tradeoff keywords\n1020\t(\"architecture\", \"approach\", \"strategy\", \"pattern\", \"vs\", \"alternative\"). If found:\n1021\t\n1022\t```\n1023\tThe plan-checker flagged an architectural decision point:\n1024\t{issue description}\n1025\t\n1026\tBrief analysis:\n1027\t- Option A: {approach_from_plan} — {pros/cons}\n1028\t- Option B: {alternative_approach} — {pros/cons}\n1029\t- Recommendation: {choice} aligned with {phase_goal}\n1030\t\n1031\tApply this to the revision? [Yes] / [No, I'll decide]\n1032\t```\n1033\t\n1034\tIf yes: include the recommendation in the revision prompt. If no: proceed to revision loop as normal.\n1035\tIf thinking_partner disabled: skip this block entirely.\n1036\t\n1037\t## 11a. Filesystem Fallback (Checker)\n1038\t\n1039\t**Triggered when:** Checker Agent() returns but the return contains neither `## VERIFICATION PASSED` nor `## ISSUES FOUND`.\n1040\t\n1041\t```bash\n1042\t# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n1043\t# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n1044\t# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n1045\t# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n1046\t# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\n1047\tDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n1048\t```\n1049\t\n1050\t**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** Plans exist on disk; the checker return was empty or truncated (the\n1051\tWindows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never arrived). Display:\n1052\t\n1053\t```text\n1054\t◆ Checker return was empty or truncated. {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) exist on disk.\n1055\t  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — checker may have completed without returning.\n1056\t```\n1057\t\n1058\tOffer 3 options:\n1059\t1. **Accept verification** — treat as `## VERIFICATION PASSED` and continue to step 13\n1060\t2. **Retry checker** — re-spawn the checker with the same prompt (return to step 10)\n1061\t3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n1062\t\n1063\t**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0:** No plans on disk — something is seriously wrong. Display error and stop.\n1064\t\n1065\t## 12. Revision Loop (Max 3 Iterations)\n1066\t\n1067\tTrack `iteration_count` (starts at 1 after initial plan + check).\n1068\tTrack `prev_issue_count` (initialized to `Infinity` before the loop begins).\n1069\tTrack `stall_reentry_count` (starts at 0; incremented each time \"Adjust approach\" re-enters step 8).\n1070\t\n1071\t**If iteration_count < 3:**\n1072\t\n1073\tParse issue count from checker return: count BLOCKER + WARNING entries in the YAML issues block (structured output from gsd-plan-checker). If the checker's return contains no YAML issues block (i.e., the plan was approved with no issues), treat `issue_count` as 0 and skip the stall check — the plan passed. Proceed to step 13.\n1074\t\n1075\tDisplay: `Revision iteration {N}/3 -- {blocker_count} blockers, {warning_count} warnings`\n1076\t\n1077\t**Stall detection:** If `issue_count >= prev_issue_count`:\n1078\t  Display: `Revision loop stalled — issue count not decreasing ({issue_count} issues remain after {N} iterations)`\n1079\t\n1080\t  **If `stall_reentry_count < 2`:**\n1081\t    Ask user:\n1082\t      Question: \"Issues remain after {N} revision attempts with no progress. Proceed with current output?\"\n1083\t      Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Adjust approach\"\n1084\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1085\t    If \"Adjust approach\": increment `stall_reentry_count`, open freeform discussion, then re-enter step 8 (full replanning). Note: re-entry resets `iteration_count` and `prev_issue_count` but `stall_reentry_count` persists across re-entries and is capped at 2.\n1086\t\n1087\t  **If `stall_reentry_count >= 2`:**\n1088\t    Display: `Stall persists after 2 re-planning attempts. The following issues could not be resolved automatically:`\n1089\t    List the remaining issues from the checker.\n1090\t    Suggest: \"Consider resolving these issues manually or running `/gsd-debug` to investigate root causes.\"\n1091\t    Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Abandon\"\n1092\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1093\t    If \"Abandon\": stop workflow.\n1094\t\n1095\tSet `prev_issue_count = issue_count`.\n1096\t\n1097\tRevision prompt:\n1098\t\n1099\t```markdown\n1100\t<revision_context>\n1101\t**Phase:** {phase_number}\n1102\t**Mode:** revision\n1103\t\n1104\t<required_reading>\n1105\t- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Existing plans)\n1106\t- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n1107\t</required_reading>\n1108\t\n1109\t${AGENT_SKILLS_PLANNER}\n1110\t\n1111\t**Checker issues:** {structured_issues_from_checker}\n1112\t</revision_context>\n1113\t\n1114\t<instructions>\n1115\tMake targeted updates to address checker issues.\n1116\tDo NOT replan from scratch unless issues are fundamental.\n1117\tReturn what changed.\n1118\t</instructions>\n1119\t```\n1120\t\n1121\t```\n1122\tAgent(\n1123\t  prompt=revision_prompt,\n1124\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n1125\t  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n1126\t  description=\"Revise Phase {phase} plans\",\n1127\t  run_in_background=true\n1128\t)\n1129\t```\n1130\t\n1131\t**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** (7.99; no marker, mtimes only) `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `PLANNER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md')` while waiting/active — `stalled` -> 1) Accept as revised, to step 13, 2) Retry, 3) Stop.\n1132\t\n1133\tAfter planner returns -> spawn checker again (step 10), increment iteration_count.\n1134\t\n1135\t**If iteration_count >= 3:**\n1136\t\n1137\tDisplay: `Max iterations reached. {N} issues remain:` + issue list\n1138\t\n1139\tOffer: 1) Force proceed, 2) Provide guidance and retry, 3) Abandon\n1140\t\n1141\t## 12.5. Plan Bounce (Optional External Refinement)\n1142\t\n1143\t**Skip if:** `--skip-bounce` flag, `--gaps` flag, or bounce is not activated.\n1144\t\n1145\t**Activation:** Bounce runs when `--bounce` flag is present OR `workflow.plan_bounce` config is `true`. The `--skip-bounce` flag always wins (disables bounce even if config enables it). The `--gaps` flag also disables bounce (gap-closure mode should not modify plans externally).\n1146\t\n1147\t**Prerequisites:** `workflow.plan_bounce_script` must be set to a valid script path. If bounce is activated but no script is configured, display warning and skip:\n1148\t```\n1149\t⚠ Plan bounce activated but no script configured.\n1150\tSet workflow.plan_bounce_script to the path of your refinement script.\n1151\tSkipping bounce step.\n1152\t```\n1153\t\n1154\t**Read pass count:**\n1155\t```bash\n1156\tBOUNCE_PASSES=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_passes 2>/dev/null || echo \"2\")\n1157\tBOUNCE_SCRIPT=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_script --raw 2>/dev/null || true)\n1158\t```\n1159\t\n1160\tDisplay banner:\n1161\t```\n1162\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1163\t GSD ► BOUNCING PLANS (External Refinement)\n1164\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1165\t\n1166\tScript: ${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\n1167\tMax passes: ${BOUNCE_PASSES}\n1168\t```\n1169\t\n1170\t**For each PLAN.md file in the phase directory:**\n1171\t\n1172\t1. **Backup:** Copy `*-PLAN.md` to `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md`\n1173\t```bash\n1174\tcp \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${PLAN_FILE%.md}.pre-bounce.md\"\n1175\t```\n1176\t\n1177\t2. **Invoke bounce script:**\n1178\t```bash\n1179\t\"${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\" \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${BOUNCE_PASSES}\"\n1180\t```\n1181\t\n1182\t3. **Validate bounced plan — YAML frontmatter integrity:**\n1183\tAfter the script returns, check that the bounced file still has valid YAML frontmatter (opening and closing `---` delimiters with parseable content between them). If the bounced plan breaks YAML frontmatter validation, restore the original from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n1184\t```\n1185\t⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} has broken YAML frontmatter — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1186\t```\n1187\t\n1188\t4. **Handle script failure:** If the bounce script exits non-zero, restore the original plan from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n1189\t```\n1190\t⚠ Bounce script failed for ${PLAN_FILE} (exit code ${EXIT_CODE}) — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1191\t```\n1192\t\n1193\t**After all plans are bounced:**\n1194\t\n1195\t5. **Re-run plan checker on bounced plans:** Spawn gsd-plan-checker (same as step 10) on all modified plans. If a bounced plan fails the checker, restore original from its pre-bounce.md backup:\n1196\t```\n1197\t⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} failed checker validation — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1198\t```\n1199\t\n1200\t6. **Commit surviving bounced plans:** If at least one plan survived both the frontmatter validation and the checker re-run, commit the changes:\n1201\t```bash\n1202\tgsd_run query commit \"refactor(${padded_phase}): bounce plans through external refinement\" --files \"${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md\"\n1203\t```\n1204\t\n1205\tDisplay summary:\n1206\t```\n1207\tPlan bounce complete: {survived}/{total} plans refined\n1208\t```\n1209\t\n1210\t**Clean up:** Remove all `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md` backup files after the bounce step completes (whether plans survived or were restored).\n1211\t\n1212\t## 13. Requirements Coverage Gate\n1213\t\n1214\tAfter plans pass the checker (or checker is skipped), verify that all phase requirements are covered by at least one plan.\n1215\t\n1216\t**Skip if:** `phase_req_ids` is null or TBD (no requirements mapped to this phase).\n1217\t\n1218\t**Step 1: Extract requirement IDs claimed by plans**\n1219\t```bash\n1220\t# Collect all requirement IDs from plan frontmatter\n1221\tPLAN_REQS=$(grep -h \"requirements_addressed\\|requirements:\" ${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u)\n1222\t```\n1223\t\n1224\t**Step 2: Compare against phase requirements from ROADMAP**\n1225\t\n1226\tFor each REQ-ID in `phase_req_ids`:\n1227\t- If REQ-ID appears in `PLAN_REQS` → covered ✓\n1228\t- If REQ-ID does NOT appear in any plan → uncovered ✗\n1229\t\n1230\t**Step 3: Check CONTEXT.md features against plan objectives**\n1231\t\n1232\tRead CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` section. Proceed anyway — accept coverage gaps\n1259\t```\n1260\t\n1261\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list (options already shown in the block above). Otherwise use AskUserQuestion to present the options.\n1262\t\n1263\t## 13a. Decision Coverage Gate\n1264\t\n1265\tVerify every trackable decision in CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` is referenced by at\n1266\tleast one plan. This **translation gate** (#2492) refuses to mark a phase planned\n1267\twhen a discuss-phase decision silently dropped.\n1268\t\n1269\t**Skip if** `workflow.context_coverage_gate` is `false` (absent = enabled), or\n1270\tno CONTEXT.md exists for this phase, or its `<decisions>` block is empty.\n1271\t\n1272\t```bash\n1273\tGATE_CFG=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.context_coverage_gate 2>/dev/null || echo \"true\")\n1274\tif [ \"$GATE_CFG\" != \"false\" ]; then\n1275\t  # #2770: CONTEXT_PATH from step-1 init doesn't survive into this Bash block;\n1276\t  # recompute it. It already\n1304\tnames each uncovered decision (`D-NN | category | text`) and tells the user\n1305\twhat to do — cite the id in a relevant plan's `must_haves` / `truths`, or\n1306\tmove the decision under `### Claude's Discretion` / tag it `[informational]`\n1307\tif it should not be tracked. Proceed anyway — accept the coverage gap\n1314\t```\n1315\t\n1316\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list. Otherwise use\n1317\tAskUserQuestion. Selecting \"Proceed anyway\" continues to step 13b but\n1318\trecords the override in STATE.md so verify-phase can re-surface it.\n1319\t\n1320\t**Why this gate blocks:** failing here is cheap. The plans are the contract\n1321\tbetween discuss-phase and execute-phase; if a decision isn't visible in any\n1322\tplan, no executor will implement it. Post-Planning Gap Analysis (plan:post capability gate dispatch)\n1360\t\n1361\tProactive, non-blocking coverage report gated on `workflow.post_planning_gaps`\n1362\t(default `true`). Dispatched via the `plan:post` capability gate owned by the\n1363\t`gap-analysis` capability (ADR-857 §53). The TDD guidance is injected via the tdd capability's contribution hook at §5.6; no inline config-get is needed.\n\nWhen `CONTEXT_WINDOW >= 500000`, the planner prompt includes the 3 most recent prior-phase CONTEXT.md/SUMMARY.md files plus any phases in the current phase's `Depends on:` field (explicit deps load regardless of recency).\n\nParse JSON for: `researcher_model`, `planner_model`, `checker_model`, `research_enabled`, `plan_checker_enabled`, `nyquist_validation_enabled`, `commit_docs`, `text_mode`, `phase_found`, `phase_dir`, `phase_number`, `phase_name`, `phase_slug`, `padded_phase`, `has_research`, `has_context`, `has_reviews`, `has_plans`, `plan_count`, `phase_status` (#3569), `planning_exists`, `roadmap_exists`, `phase_req_ids`, `response_language`, `granularity`.\n\n**#2517:** omit the `model=` param from an `Agent()` call when its `researcher`/`planner`/`checker`_model is `\"inherit\"` or empty — passing `model=\"\"` 404s on non-Claude runtimes; omitting inherits the orchestrator model (mirrors execute-phase).\n\n**If `response_language` is set:** All user-facing orchestrator output MUST be in `{response_language}`; technical terms, code, paths, and subagent prompts stay in English. Closed-Phase Gate (#3569)\n\nRead and execute `gsd-core/workflows/plan-phase/steps/closed-phase-gate.md` — it parses `phase_status` from the init JSON, sets `FORCE_REPLAN` from `$ARGUMENTS`, and hard-stops replanning a `Complete` phase: `--reviews` on a closed phase is never overridable (exit 1), and replanning otherwise requires `--force` (else exit 1, pointing at `${verification_path}`); under `--force` it continues but emits a WARNING banner. Only `Complete` is gated — `Executed` / `Needs Review` are legitimate replans.\n\n## 2. Parse and Normalize Arguments\n\nExtract from $ARGUMENTS: phase number (integer or decimal like `2.1`), flags (`--research`, `--skip-research`, `--research-phase <N>`, `--gaps`, `--skip-verify`, `--skip-ui`, `--prd <filepath>`, `--ingest <path-or-glob>`, `--ingest-format <auto|nygard|madr|narrative>`, `--reviews`, `--text`, `--bounce`, `--skip-bounce`, `--chunked`, `--mvp`, `--no-tracer`, `--no-reversibility-gates`, `--tdd`, `--granularity <coarse|standard|fine>`, `--force` (override closed-phase gate, see §1.5)).\n\n**`--research-phase <N>` — research-only mode (#3042 + #3044).** When this flag is present, parse `<N>` as the phase number (overrides any positional phase argument), set `RESEARCH_ONLY=true`, and treat the rest of this workflow as a research-dispatch only — the planner spawn (step 8), plan-checker, verification, gaps, bounce, and post-planning-gaps blocks all skip on `RESEARCH_ONLY`. Use this for cross-phase research, doc review before committing to a planning approach, and correction-without-replanning loops. Replaces the deleted `/gsd-research-phase` command.\n\nIn research-only mode, two modifiers control behavior when `RESEARCH.md` already exists:\n\n- **`--research`** — force-refresh re-research without prompting. Re-spawns the researcher unconditionally and overwrites the existing RESEARCH.md. (This is the existing `--research` flag's standard \"force re-research\" semantics, reused here.)\n- **`--view`** — view-only: print existing `RESEARCH.md` to stdout, do **not** spawn the researcher. Sets `VIEW_ONLY=true`. Cheapest mode for the correction-without-replanning loop. If `RESEARCH.md` does not exist, error with a hint to drop `--view`.\n\n```bash\nRESEARCH_ONLY=false\nVIEW_ONLY=false\nif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --research-phase[[:space:]]+([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?) ]]; then\n  RESEARCH_ONLY=true\n  PHASE=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\nfi\nif $RESEARCH_ONLY && [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--view([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then\n  VIEW_ONLY=true\nfi\n```\n\n**`--granularity <coarse|standard|fine>` — CLI override (#703).** When present, this value is the resolved granularity passed to the planner — it wins over any per-phase `granularities.<type>` config, top-level `granularity` config, or project defaults. The init JSON always includes a `granularity` field reflecting the resolved value; read it from there. Invalid values (anything other than `coarse`, `standard`, `fine`) cause an error at the CLI boundary.\n\nSet `TEXT_MODE=true` if `--text` is present in $ARGUMENTS OR `text_mode` from init JSON is `true`. When `TEXT_MODE` is active, replace every `AskUserQuestion` call with a plain-text numbered list and ask the user to type their choice number. This is required for Claude Code remote sessions (`/rc` mode) where TUI menus don't work through the Claude App.\n\n**MVP_MODE resolution.** Resolve `MVP_MODE` once via the centralized `phase.mvp-mode` query verb. Precedence (first hit wins): CLI flag → ROADMAP.md `**Mode:** mvp` → `workflow.mvp_mode` config → false. The verb is the single source of truth — do not re-implement the chain.\n\n```bash\nMVP_FLAG_ARG=\"\"\nif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--mvp([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then MVP_FLAG_ARG=\"--cli-flag\"; fi\nif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--tdd([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then\n  gsd_run query config-set workflow.tdd_mode true 2>/dev/null || true\nfi\n# Tracer-first is the default; --no-tracer opts back into the legacy horizontal-layer shape.\nTRACER_MODE=true\nif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--no-tracer([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then TRACER_MODE=false; fi\nREVERSIBILITY_GATES=true\nif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--no-reversibility-gates([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then REVERSIBILITY_GATES=false; fi\n```\n\n**Baseline-discipline flags.** `TRACER_MODE` and `REVERSIBILITY_GATES` default to `true`; neither is persisted per-phase nor read from config.\n\nDefer the `phase.mvp-mode` query until `PHASE` is finalized (after explicit argument parsing/fallback phase detection + validation). The verb returns `true|false`; full result also exposes `source` (`cli_flag` | `roadmap` | `config` | `none`) for diagnostics. Mode is **all-or-nothing per phase** (PRD decision Q1).\n\n**Walking Skeleton gate.** When `MVP_MODE=true` AND `phase_number == \"01\"` AND there are zero prior phase summaries (new project), the planner runs in **Walking Skeleton mode** (per PRD decision Q2 — new projects only). The plan-review-convergence source-grounding pass reads this section to exclude newly-created symbols from drift verification; omitting it causes new symbols to be flagged for acknowledgement.\n</downstream_consumer>\n\n<deep_work_rules>\n## Anti-Shallow Execution Rules (MANDATORY)\n\nEvery task MUST include these fields — they are NOT optional:\n\n1. **`<read_first>`** — Files the executor MUST read before touching anything. Always include:\n   - The file being modified (so executor sees current state, not assumptions)\n   - Any \"source of truth\" file referenced in CONTEXT.md (reference implementations, existing patterns, config files, schemas)\n   - Any file whose patterns, signatures, types, or conventions must be replicated or respected\n\n2. **`<acceptance_criteria>`** — Verifiable conditions that prove the task was done correctly. Rules:\n   - Every criterion must be checkable as a source assertion, behavior assertion, test command, or CLI output\n   - NEVER use subjective language (\"looks correct\", \"properly configured\", \"consistent with\")\n   - Include exact strings, patterns, values, command outputs, or observable behavior where that is the right proof\n   - Examples:\n     - Code: `auth.py contains def verify_token(` / `test_auth.py exits 0`\n     - Behavior: `POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + httpOnly JWT cookie for valid credentials`\n     - Config: `.env.example contains DATABASE_URL=` / `Dockerfile contains HEALTHCHECK`\n     - Docs: `README.md contains '## Installation'` / `API.md lists all endpoints`\n     - Infra: `deploy.yml has rollback step` / `docker-compose.yml has healthcheck for db`\n\n3. **`<action>`** — Must include CONCRETE values, not references. Rules:\n   - NEVER say \"align X with Y\", \"match X to Y\", \"update to be consistent\" without specifying the exact target state\n   - Include concrete identifiers and reference values: config keys, function signatures, SQL table names, class names, import paths, env vars, endpoint paths, etc.\n   - If CONTEXT.md has a comparison table or expected values, copy only the target identifiers/values needed to remove ambiguity\n   - Do not include full file contents, fenced code blocks, or complete implementations in `<action>`\n   - The executor should understand the intended target state from `<action>` and use `<read_first>` files for current implementation details, patterns, and source-of-truth context\n\n**Why this matters:** Executor agents work from the plan text. Vague instructions like \"update the config to match production\" produce shallow one-line changes. Concrete instructions like \"add DATABASE_URL, set POOL_SIZE=20, add REDIS_URL, and read config/runtime.ts before editing\" produce complete work without turning the planner into the executor.\n</deep_work_rules>\n\n<quality_gate>\n- [ ] PLAN.md files created in phase directory\n- [ ] Each plan has valid frontmatter\n- [ ] Tasks are specific and actionable\n- [ ] Every task has `<read_first>` with at least the file being modified\n- [ ] Every task has `<acceptance_criteria>` with behavior, test-command, CLI, or source assertions\n- [ ] Every `<action>` contains concrete identifiers without fenced code blocks or full implementations\n- [ ] Dependencies correctly identified\n- [ ] Waves assigned for parallel execution\n- [ ] must_haves derived from phase goal\n- [ ] Every PLAN.md includes an \"Artifacts this phase produces\" section listing symbols created by this phase (decorators, classes, functions, CLI flags, struct/dataclass fields, new file paths)\n- [ ] Every SPEC ## Edge Coverage resolved edge is represented in a plan's must_haves (no silent drops)\n- [ ] Every UI-SPEC ## UI Considerations resolved consideration is represented in a plan's must_haves (no silent drops)\n- [ ] Every SPEC ## Prohibitions resolved item is represented in a plan's must_haves.prohibitions (no silent drops)\n</quality_gate>\n```\n\n**If `CHUNKED_MODE` is `false` (default):** Spawn the planner as a single long-lived Agent:\n\n```text\nAgent(\n  prompt=filled_prompt,\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n  description=\"Plan Phase {phase}\",\n  run_in_background=true\n)\n```\n\n**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `PLANNER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md' \"## PLANNING COMPLETE\" \"## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED\" \"## ⚠ Source Audit\" \"## CHECKPOINT REACHED\" \"## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE\")` while waiting/active — `marker_received` -> step 9; `stalled` -> 9a.\n\n**If `CHUNKED_MODE` is `true`:** Skip the Agent() call above — proceed to step 8.5 instead.\n\nIf `section_manifest` is `null` or `\"chunked-planning-mode\"` is in its `included` list: read and execute `gsd-core/workflows/plan-phase/steps/chunked-planning-mode.md`. Otherwise skip — do not read the file.\n\n## 9. Handle Planner Return\n\n- **`## PLANNING COMPLETE`:** Display plan count. If `--skip-verify` or `plan_checker_enabled` is false (from init): skip to step 13. Otherwise: step 10.\n- **`## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`:** The planner determined the phase exceeds the context budget for full-fidelity implementation of all source items. Handle in step 9b.\n- **`## ⚠ Source Audit: Unplanned Items Found`:** The planner's multi-source coverage audit found items from REQUIREMENTS.md, RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP goal, or CONTEXT.md decisions that are not covered by any plan. Handle in step 9c.\n- **`## CHECKPOINT REACHED`:** Present to user, get response, spawn continuation (step 12)\n- **`## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE`:** Show attempts, offer: Add context / Retry / Manual\n- **Empty / truncated / no recognized marker:** → Filesystem fallback (step 9a).\n\n## 9a. Filesystem Fallback (Planner)\n\n**Triggered when:** Agent() returns but the return contains no recognized marker (`## PLANNING COMPLETE`, `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, `## ⚠ Source Audit`, `## CHECKPOINT REACHED`, `## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE`).\n\n```bash\n# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\nDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n```\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** The planner wrote plans to disk but the Agent() return was empty or\ntruncated (the Windows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never\narrived). Display:\n\n```text\n◆ Planner wrote {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) to disk but did not emit a PLANNING COMPLETE marker.\n  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — work is likely recoverable.\n\n  Plans found on disk:\n  {ls output of *-PLAN.md}\n```\n\nOffer 3 options:\n1. **Accept plans** — treat as `## PLANNING COMPLETE` and continue through step 9 `## PLANNING COMPLETE` handling (so `--skip-verify` / `plan_checker_enabled=false` are honored — may skip to step 13 rather than step 10)\n2. **Retry planner** — re-spawn the planner with the same prompt (return to step 8)\n3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0 and no marker:** The planner produced no output. Treat as\n`## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE` and handle accordingly.\n\n## 9b. Handle Phase Split Recommendation\n\nWhen the planner returns `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, it means the phase's source items exceed the context budget for full-fidelity implementation. The planner proposes groupings.\n\n**Extract from planner return:**\n- Proposed sub-phases (e.g., \"17a: processing core (D-01 to D-19)\", \"17b: billing + config UX (D-20 to D-27)\")\n- Which source items (REQ-IDs, D-XX decisions, RESEARCH items) go in each sub-phase\n- Why the split is necessary (context cost estimate, file count)\n\n**Present to user:**\n```\n## Phase {X} exceeds context budget for full-fidelity implementation\n\nThe planner found {N} source items that exceed the context budget when\nplanned at full fidelity. Instead of reducing scope, we recommend splitting:\n\n**Option 1: Split into sub-phases**\n- Phase {X}a: {name} — {items} ({N} source items, ~{P}% context)\n- Phase {X}b: {name} — {items} ({M} source items, ~{Q}% context)\n\n**Option 2: Proceed anyway** (planner will attempt all, quality may degrade past 50% context)\n\n**Option 3: Prioritize** — you choose which items to implement now,\nrest become a follow-up phase\n```\n\nUse AskUserQuestion with these 3 options.\n\n**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` to create the sub-phases, then replan each.\n**If \"Proceed\":** Return to planner with instruction to attempt all items at full fidelity, accepting more plans/tasks.\n**If \"Prioritize\":** Use AskUserQuestion (multiSelect) to let user pick which items are \"now\" vs \"later\". Create CONTEXT.md for each sub-phase with the selected items.\n\n## 9c. Handle Source Audit Gaps\n\nWhen the planner returns `## ⚠ Source Audit: Unplanned Items Found`, it means items from REQUIREMENTS.md, RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP goal, or CONTEXT.md decisions have no corresponding plan.\n\n**Extract from planner return:**\n- Each unplanned item with its source artifact and section\n- The planner's suggested options (A: add plan, B: split phase, C: defer with confirmation)\n\n**Present each gap to user.** For each unplanned item:\n\n```\n## ⚠ Unplanned: {item description}\n\nSource: {RESEARCH.md / REQUIREMENTS.md / ROADMAP goal / CONTEXT.md}\nDetails: {why the planner flagged this}\n\nOptions:\n1. Add a plan to cover this item (recommended)\n2. Split phase — move to a sub-phase with related items\n3. Defer — add to backlog (developer confirms this is intentional)\n```\n\nUse AskUserQuestion for each gap (or batch if multiple gaps).\n\n**If \"Add plan\":** Return to planner (step 8) with instruction to add plans covering the missing items, preserving existing plans.\n**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` for overflow items, then replan.\n**If \"Defer\":** Record in CONTEXT.md `## Deferred Ideas` with developer's confirmation. Proceed to step 10.\n\n## 10. Spawn gsd-plan-checker Agent\n\nDisplay banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► VERIFYING PLANS\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n◆ Spawning plan checker... (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n```\n\nChecker prompt:\n\n```markdown\n<verification_context>\n**Phase:** {phase_number}\n**Phase Goal:** {goal from ROADMAP}\n**Mode:** {standard | gap_closure | reviews}\n\n<required_reading>\n- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Plans to verify)\n- {roadmap_path} (Roadmap)\n- {requirements_path} (Requirements)\n- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n- {research_path} (Technical Research — includes Validation Architecture)\n- {reviews_path} (Cross-AI Review Feedback - if --reviews; verify actionable findings are represented in PLAN.md)\n</required_reading>\n\n${AGENT_SKILLS_CHECKER}\n\n<review_incorporation_verification>\n**If Mode is reviews:** Read REVIEWS.md and verify each current actionable review finding is visible in executable PLAN.md content or explicitly deferred/rejected in the relevant PLAN.md. A finding remains actionable if it requires a concrete plan task, `<action>`, `<acceptance_criteria>`, `<verify>`, `must_haves`, threat-model item, stale-path correction, or execution contract change before /gsd-execute-phase runs.\n\nIf an actionable finding remains only in REVIEWS.md and would be invisible to /gsd-execute-phase, return `## ISSUES FOUND`. Use WARNING by default; use BLOCKER when the missing incorporation can prevent the phase goal, create unsafe execution, or invalidate verification.\n</review_incorporation_verification>\n\n**Phase requirement IDs (MUST ALL be covered):** {phase_req_ids}\n\n**Project instructions:** Read ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md if either exists — verify plans honor project guidelines\n**Project skills:** Check .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/ directory (if either exists) — verify plans account for project skill rules\n</verification_context>\n\n<expected_output>\n- ## VERIFICATION PASSED — all checks pass\n- ## ISSUES FOUND — structured issue list\n</expected_output>\n```\n\n```\nAgent(\n  prompt=checker_prompt,\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-plan-checker\",\n  model=\"{checker_model}\",\n  description=\"Verify Phase {phase} plans\",\n  run_in_background=true\n)\n```\n\n**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `CHECKER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md' \"## VERIFICATION PASSED\" \"## ISSUES FOUND\")` while waiting/active.\n\n## 11. Handle Checker Return\n\n- **`marker_received` + `## VERIFICATION PASSED`:** Display confirmation, proceed to step 13.\n- **`marker_received` + `## ISSUES FOUND`:** Display issues, check iteration count, proceed to step 12.\n- **`stalled`:** Automatically surface 11a's recovery choice (Accept verification / Retry checker / Stop) — no manual interrupt needed.\n- **Empty / truncated / no recognized marker:** → Filesystem fallback (step 11a).\n\n**Thinking partner for architectural tradeoffs (conditional):**\nIf `features.thinking_partner` is enabled, scan the checker's issues for architectural tradeoff keywords\n(\"architecture\", \"approach\", \"strategy\", \"pattern\", \"vs\", \"alternative\"). If found:\n\n```\nThe plan-checker flagged an architectural decision point:\n{issue description}\n\nBrief analysis:\n- Option A: {approach_from_plan} — {pros/cons}\n- Option B: {alternative_approach} — {pros/cons}\n- Recommendation: {choice} aligned with {phase_goal}\n\nApply this to the revision? [Yes] / [No, I'll decide]\n```\n\nIf yes: include the recommendation in the revision prompt. If no: proceed to revision loop as normal.\nIf thinking_partner disabled: skip this block entirely.\n\n## 11a. Filesystem Fallback (Checker)\n\n**Triggered when:** Checker Agent() returns but the return contains neither `## VERIFICATION PASSED` nor `## ISSUES FOUND`.\n\n```bash\n# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\nDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n```\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** Plans exist on disk; the checker return was empty or truncated (the\nWindows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never arrived). Display:\n\n```text\n◆ Checker return was empty or truncated. {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) exist on disk.\n  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — checker may have completed without returning.\n```\n\nOffer 3 options:\n1. **Accept verification** — treat as `## VERIFICATION PASSED` and continue to step 13\n2. **Retry checker** — re-spawn the checker with the same prompt (return to step 10)\n3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0:** No plans on disk — something is seriously wrong. Display error and stop.\n\n## 12. Revision Loop (Max 3 Iterations)\n\nTrack `iteration_count` (starts at 1 after initial plan + check).\nTrack `prev_issue_count` (initialized to `Infinity` before the loop begins).\nTrack `stall_reentry_count` (starts at 0; incremented each time \"Adjust approach\" re-enters step 8).\n\n**If iteration_count < 3:**\n\nParse issue count from checker return: count BLOCKER + WARNING entries in the YAML issues block (structured output from gsd-plan-checker). If the checker's return contains no YAML issues block (i.e., the plan was approved with no issues), treat `issue_count` as 0 and skip the stall check — the plan passed. Proceed to step 13.\n\nDisplay: `Revision iteration {N}/3 -- {blocker_count} blockers, {warning_count} warnings`\n\n**Stall detection:** If `issue_count >= prev_issue_count`:\n  Display: `Revision loop stalled — issue count not decreasing ({issue_count} issues remain after {N} iterations)`\n\n  **If `stall_reentry_count < 2`:**\n    Ask user:\n      Question: \"Issues remain after {N} revision attempts with no progress. Proceed with current output?\"\n      Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Adjust approach\"\n    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n    If \"Adjust approach\": increment `stall_reentry_count`, open freeform discussion, then re-enter step 8 (full replanning). Note: re-entry resets `iteration_count` and `prev_issue_count` but `stall_reentry_count` persists across re-entries and is capped at 2.\n\n  **If `stall_reentry_count >= 2`:**\n    Display: `Stall persists after 2 re-planning attempts. The following issues could not be resolved automatically:`\n    List the remaining issues from the checker.\n    Suggest: \"Consider resolving these issues manually or running `/gsd-debug` to investigate root causes.\"\n    Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Abandon\"\n    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n    If \"Abandon\": stop workflow.\n\nSet `prev_issue_count = issue_count`.\n\nRevision prompt:\n\n```markdown\n<revision_context>\n**Phase:** {phase_number}\n**Mode:** revision\n\n<required_reading>\n- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Existing plans)\n- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n</required_reading>\n\n${AGENT_SKILLS_PLANNER}\n\n**Checker issues:** {structured_issues_from_checker}\n</revision_context>\n\n<instructions>\nMake targeted updates to address checker issues.\nDo NOT replan from scratch unless issues are fundamental.\nReturn what changed.\n</instructions>\n```\n\n```\nAgent(\n  prompt=revision_prompt,\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n  description=\"Revise Phase {phase} plans\",\n  run_in_background=true\n)\n```\n\n**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** (7.99; no marker, mtimes only) `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `PLANNER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md')` while waiting/active — `stalled` -> 1) Accept as revised, to step 13, 2) Retry, 3) Stop.\n\nAfter planner returns -> spawn checker again (step 10), increment iteration_count.\n\n**If iteration_count >= 3:**\n\nDisplay: `Max iterations reached. {N} issues remain:` + issue list\n\nOffer: 1) Force proceed, 2) Provide guidance and retry, 3) Abandon\n\n## 12.5. Plan Bounce (Optional External Refinement)\n\n**Skip if:** `--skip-bounce` flag, `--gaps` flag, or bounce is not activated.\n\n**Activation:** Bounce runs when `--bounce` flag is present OR `workflow.plan_bounce` config is `true`. The `--skip-bounce` flag always wins (disables bounce even if config enables it). The `--gaps` flag also disables bounce (gap-closure mode should not modify plans externally).\n\n**Prerequisites:** `workflow.plan_bounce_script` must be set to a valid script path. If bounce is activated but no script is configured, display warning and skip:\n```\n⚠ Plan bounce activated but no script configured.\nSet workflow.plan_bounce_script to the path of your refinement script.\nSkipping bounce step.\n```\n\n**Read pass count:**\n```bash\nBOUNCE_PASSES=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_passes 2>/dev/null || echo \"2\")\nBOUNCE_SCRIPT=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_script --raw 2>/dev/null || true)\n```\n\nDisplay banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► BOUNCING PLANS (External Refinement)\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\nScript: ${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\nMax passes: ${BOUNCE_PASSES}\n```\n\n**For each PLAN.md file in the phase directory:**\n\n1. **Backup:** Copy `*-PLAN.md` to `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md`\n```bash\ncp \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${PLAN_FILE%.md}.pre-bounce.md\"\n```\n\n2. **Invoke bounce script:**\n```bash\n\"${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\" \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${BOUNCE_PASSES}\"\n```\n\n3. **Validate bounced plan — YAML frontmatter integrity:**\nAfter the script returns, check that the bounced file still has valid YAML frontmatter (opening and closing `---` delimiters with parseable content between them). If the bounced plan breaks YAML frontmatter validation, restore the original from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n```\n⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} has broken YAML frontmatter — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n4. **Handle script failure:** If the bounce script exits non-zero, restore the original plan from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n```\n⚠ Bounce script failed for ${PLAN_FILE} (exit code ${EXIT_CODE}) — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n**After all plans are bounced:**\n\n5. **Re-run plan checker on bounced plans:** Spawn gsd-plan-checker (same as step 10) on all modified plans. If a bounced plan fails the checker, restore original from its pre-bounce.md backup:\n```\n⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} failed checker validation — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n6. **Commit surviving bounced plans:** If at least one plan survived both the frontmatter validation and the checker re-run, commit the changes:\n```bash\ngsd_run query commit \"refactor(${padded_phase}): bounce plans through external refinement\" --files \"${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md\"\n```\n\nDisplay summary:\n```\nPlan bounce complete: {survived}/{total} plans refined\n```\n\n**Clean up:** Remove all `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md` backup files after the bounce step completes (whether plans survived or were restored).\n\n## 13. Requirements Coverage Gate\n\nAfter plans pass the checker (or checker is skipped), verify that all phase requirements are covered by at least one plan.\n\n**Skip if:** `phase_req_ids` is null or TBD (no requirements mapped to this phase).\n\n**Step 1: Extract requirement IDs claimed by plans**\n```bash\n# Collect all requirement IDs from plan frontmatter\nPLAN_REQS=$(grep -h \"requirements_addressed\\|requirements:\" ${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u)\n```\n\n**Step 2: Compare against phase requirements from ROADMAP**\n\nFor each REQ-ID in `phase_req_ids`:\n- If REQ-ID appears in `PLAN_REQS` → covered ✓\n- If REQ-ID does NOT appear in any plan → uncovered ✗\n\n**Step 3: Check CONTEXT.md features against plan objectives**\n\nRead CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` section. Extract feature/capability names. Check each against plan `<objective>` blocks. Features not mentioned in any plan objective → potentially dropped.\n\n**Step 4: Report**\n\nIf all requirements covered and no dropped features:\n```\n✓ Requirements coverage: {N}/{N} REQ-IDs covered by plans\n```\n→ Proceed to step 14.\n\nIf gaps found:\n```\n## ⚠ Requirements Coverage Gap\n\n{M} of {N} phase requirements are not assigned to any plan:\n\n| REQ-ID | Description | Plans |\n|--------|-------------|-------|\n| {id} | {from REQUIREMENTS.md} | None |\n\n{K} CONTEXT.md features not found in plan objectives:\n- {feature_name} — described in CONTEXT.md but no plan covers it\n\nOptions:\n1. Re-plan to include missing requirements (recommended)\n2. Move uncovered requirements to next phase\n3. Proceed anyway — accept coverage gaps\n```\n\nIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list (options already shown in the block above). Otherwise use AskUserQuestion to present the options.\n\n## 13a. Decision Coverage Gate\n\nVerify every trackable decision in CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` is referenced by at\nleast one plan. This **translation gate** (#2492) refuses to mark a phase planned\nwhen a discuss-phase decision silently dropped.\n\n**Skip if** `workflow.context_coverage_gate` is `false` (absent = enabled), or\nno CONTEXT.md exists for this phase, or its `<decisions>` block is empty.\n\n```bash\nGATE_CFG=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.context_coverage_gate 2>/dev/null || echo \"true\")\nif [ \"$GATE_CFG\" != \"false\" ]; then\n  # #2770: CONTEXT_PATH from step-1 init doesn't survive into this Bash block;\n  # recompute it. Only run when a CONTEXT.md exists (handler fails closed on an\n  # empty arg, so an unguarded empty glob would halt a context-less phase).\n  CONTEXT_PATH=$(ls \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-CONTEXT.md 2>/dev/null | head -1)\n  if [ -n \"$CONTEXT_PATH\" ]; then\n    GATE_RESULT=$(gsd_run query check.decision-coverage-plan \"${PHASE_DIR}\" \"${CONTEXT_PATH}\")\n    # BLOCKING: refuse to mark phase planned when a trackable decision is uncovered.\n    # `passed: true` covers both real-pass and skipped cases (gate disabled / no CONTEXT.md /\n    # no trackable decisions). Verify-phase counterpart deliberately omits this exit-1 — that\n    # gate is non-blocking by design (review finding F15).\n    echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -e '(.passed // .data.passed) == true' >/dev/null || {\n      echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -r '(.message // .data.message // \"Decision coverage gate failed.\")'\n      exit 1\n    }\n  fi\nfi\n```\n\nThe handler returns JSON:\n```json\n{ \"passed\": true, \"skipped\": false, \"total\": 2, \"covered\": 2,\n  \"uncovered\": [{ \"id\": \"D-01\", \"text\": \"...\", \"category\": \"...\" }], \"message\": \"...\" }\n```\n\n**If `passed` is true (or `skipped` is true):** Display\n`✓ Decision coverage: {M}/{N} decisions covered` (or `(skipped)`) and proceed\nto step 13b.\n\n**If `passed` is false:** Display the handler's `message` block. It already\nnames each uncovered decision (`D-NN | category | text`) and tells the user\nwhat to do — cite the id in a relevant plan's `must_haves` / `truths`, or\nmove the decision under `### Claude's Discretion` / tag it `[informational]`\nif it should not be tracked. Then offer:\n\n```text\nOptions:\n1. Re-plan to cover missing decisions (recommended)\n2. Edit CONTEXT.md to mark dropped decisions as [informational] / Discretion\n3. Proceed anyway — accept the coverage gap\n```\n\nIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list. Otherwise use\nAskUserQuestion. Selecting \"Proceed anyway\" continues to step 13b but\nrecords the override in STATE.md so verify-phase can re-surface it.\n\n**Why this gate blocks:** failing here is cheap. The plans are the contract\nbetween discuss-phase and execute-phase; if a decision isn't visible in any\nplan, no executor will implement it. Catching that now beats discovering it\nafter thousands of dollars of execution.\n\n## 13b. Record Planning Completion in STATE.md\n\nAfter plans pass all gates, record that planning is complete so STATE.md reflects the new phase status:\n\n```bash\ngsd_run query state.planned-phase --phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" --name \"${PHASE_NAME}\" --plans \"${PLAN_COUNT}\"\n```\n\nThis updates STATUS to \"Ready to execute\", sets the correct plan count, and timestamps Last Activity.\n\n## 13c. Capture decisions for downstream agents.\n</philosophy>\n\n<scope_guardrail>\n**CRITICAL: No scope creep.** The phase boundary comes from ROADMAP.md and is FIXED. Discussion clarifies HOW to implement what's scoped, never WHETHER to add new capabilities.\n\n**Allowed (clarifying ambiguity):** \"How should posts be displayed?\" (layout), \"What happens on empty state?\" (within the feature), \"Pull to refresh or manual?\" (behavior choice).\n\n**Not allowed (scope creep):** \"Should we also add comments?\" / \"What about search/filtering?\" / \"Maybe include bookmarking?\" — those are new capabilities and belong in their own phase.\n\n**Heuristic:** Does this clarify how we implement what's already in the phase, or does it add a new capability that could be its own phase?\n\n**When user suggests scope creep:**\n```\n\"[Feature X] would be a new capability — that's its own phase.\nWant me to note it for the roadmap backlog?\n\nFor now, let's focus on [phase domain].\"\n```\n\nCapture the idea in a \"Deferred Ideas\" section. Don't lose it, don't act on it.\n</scope_guardrail>\n\n<gray_area_identification>\nGray areas are **implementation decisions the user cares about** — things that could go multiple ways and would change the result.\n\n1. Read the phase goal from ROADMAP.md\n2. Understand the domain — something users SEE / CALL / RUN / READ / something being ORGANIZED — and let that drive what kinds of decisions matter\n3. Generate phase-specific gray areas (not generic categories)\n\n**Don't use generic category labels** (UI, UX, Behavior). Generate specific gray areas. Examples:\n\n```\nPhase: \"User authentication\"     → Session handling, Error responses, Multi-device policy, Recovery flow\nPhase: \"Organize photo library\"  → Grouping criteria, Duplicate handling, Naming convention, Folder structure\nPhase: \"CLI for database backups\"→ Output format, Flag design, Progress reporting, Error recovery\nPhase: \"API documentation\"       → Structure/navigation, Code examples depth, Versioning approach, Interactive elements\n```\n\n**Claude handles these (don't ask):** technical implementation details, architecture patterns, performance optimization, scope (roadmap defines this).\n</gray_area_identification>\n\n<answer_validation>\n**IMPORTANT: Answer validation** — After every AskUserQuestion call, if the response is empty/whitespace-only:\n\n- **\"Other\" with empty text** (the user wants to type freeform): output `\"What would you like to discuss?\"`, STOP generating, wait for the user's next message, then reflect it back and continue. Do NOT retry AskUserQuestion or call any tools.\n- **Any other empty response:** retry once with the same parameters; if still empty, present options as a plain-text numbered list. Never proceed with empty input.\n\n**Text mode** (`--text` or `workflow.text_mode: true`): follow `workflows/discuss-phase/modes/text.md` — do not use AskUserQuestion at all.\n</answer_validation>\n\n<process>\n\n**Express path available:** If you already have a PRD or acceptance criteria document, use `/gsd-plan-phase {phase} --prd path/to/prd.md` to skip this discussion and go straight to planning.\n\n<step name=\"initialize\" priority=\"first\">\nPhase number from argument (required).\n\n```bash\n_GSD_SHIM_NAME=\"gsd-tools.cjs\"; Closed-Phase Gate (#3569)\n93\t\n94\tThe init JSON includes `phase_status` — one of `Pending | Planned | In Progress | Executed | Complete | Needs Review`. `Complete` means the phase has all summaries AND a `VERIFICATION.md` with `status: passed`. Replanning a closed phase silently rewrites plan docs that no longer match the shipped code, so the workflow must hard-stop here unless the operator explicitly overrides.\n95\t\n96\tParse `phase_status` from the init JSON, then:\n97\t\n98\t```bash\n99\tFORCE_REPLAN=false\n100\tif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--force([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then\n101\t  FORCE_REPLAN=true\n102\tfi\n103\t\n104\tif [ \"${phase_status}\" = \"Complete\" ]; then\n105\t  if [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ (^|[[:space:]])--reviews([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then\n106\t    # --reviews on a closed phase is never legitimate — concerns belong in a\n107\t    # new phase or issue against the closed phase's commits.\n108\t    cat <<EOF >&2\n109\tPhase ${phase_number} (${phase_name}) is already CLOSED (VERIFICATION status: passed).\n110\t/gsd-plan-phase --reviews cannot replan a closed phase. Verify the closeout was wrong before committing new plan docs.\" >&2\n130\tfi\n131\t```\n132\t\n133\tThe gate fires only on `Complete`. `Executed` and `Needs Review` are not gated — those states mean planning was finished but verification did not pass, and replanning is a legitimate next step.\n134\t\n135\t## 2. The verb returns `true|false`; full result also exposes `source` (`cli_flag` | `roadmap` | `config` | `none`) for diagnostics. Mode is **all-or-nothing per phase** (PRD decision Q1).\n173\t\n174\t**Walking Skeleton gate.** When `MVP_MODE=true` AND `phase_number == \"01\"` AND there are zero prior phase summaries (new project), the planner runs in **Walking Skeleton mode** (per PRD decision Q2 — new projects only). Detect with:\n175\t\n176\t```bash\n177\tWALKING_SKELETON=false\n178\tif [ \"$MVP_MODE\" = \"true\" ] && [ \"$padded_phase\" = \"01\" ]; then\n179\t  PRIOR_SUMMARIES=$(gsd_run query phases.list --pick summaries_total 2>/dev/null || echo \"0\")\n180\t  if [ \"$PRIOR_SUMMARIES\" = \"0\" ]; then WALKING_SKELETON=true; fi\n181\tfi\n182\t```\n183\t\n184\tWhen `WALKING_SKELETON=true`:\n185\t- Planner is instructed to produce `SKELETON.md` in the phase directory alongside `PLAN.md`. The template lives at `$HOME/.claude/gsd-core/references/skeleton-template.md` — the planner reads it when producing SKELETON.md (lazy; not loaded on non-skeleton runs).\n186\t- The plan must scaffold project + routing + one real DB read/write + one real UI interaction + dev deployment — the thinnest possible end-to-end working slice.\n187\t\n188\t**Interaction with `--prd <filepath>`.** `--mvp` and `--prd` compose. The PRD express path (Step 3.5) creates `CONTEXT.md` from the PRD file and continues to research; the Walking Skeleton gate fires independently from the conditions above. When both are active on Phase 1 of a new project, the planner receives `WALKING_SKELETON=true` and PRD-derived context simultaneously — the PRD informs *what the skeleton should prove*. No precedence is needed; the two signals are orthogonal. See [`references/mvp-concepts.md`](../references/mvp-concepts.md) for the broader interaction map.\n189\t\n190\tExtract express-path args from $ARGUMENTS: `PRD_FILE` (`--prd <filepath>`), `INGEST_PATH` (`--ingest <path-or-glob>`), and optional `INGEST_FORMAT` (`--ingest-format <auto|nygard|madr|narrative>`, default `auto`).\n191\t\n192\t`--prd` and `--ingest` are mutually exclusive. If both are present, error and exit:\n193\t`Invalid arguments: cannot combine \\`--prd\\` with \\`--ingest\\`.`\n194\t\n195\t**If no phase number:** Detect next unplanned phase from roadmap.\n196\t\n197\t**If `phase_found` is false:** Validate phase exists in ROADMAP.md. If valid, create the directory using `expected_phase_dir` from init (includes `project_code` prefix when set):\n198\t```bash\n199\tmkdir -p \"${expected_phase_dir}\"\n200\t```\n201\t\n202\tSet `phase_dir=\"${expected_phase_dir}\"` after creation.\n203\t\n204\t**Existing artifacts from init:** `has_research`, `has_plans`, `plan_count`.\n205\t\n206\tSet `CHUNKED_MODE` from flag or config:\n207\t```bash\n208\tCHUNKED_CFG=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_chunked 2>/dev/null || echo \"false\")\n209\tCHUNKED_MODE=false\n210\tif [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --chunked ]] || [[ \"$CHUNKED_CFG\" == \"true\" ]]; then\n211\t  CHUNKED_MODE=true\n212\tfi\n213\t```\n214\t\n215\t## 2.5. Validate `--reviews` Prerequisite\n216\t\n217\t**Skip if:** No `--reviews` flag.\n218\t\n219\t**If `--reviews` AND `--gaps`:** Error — cannot combine `--reviews` with `--gaps`. These are conflicting modes.\n220\t\n221\t**If `--reviews` AND `has_reviews` is false (no REVIEWS.md in phase dir):**\n222\t\n223\tError:\n224\t```\n225\tNo REVIEWS.md found for Phase {N}. Run reviews first:\n226\t\n227\t/gsd-review --phase {N}\n228\t\n229\tThen re-run /gsd-plan-phase {N} --reviews\n230\t```\n231\tExit workflow.\n232\t\n233\t## 3. Validate Phase\n234\t\n235\t```bash\n236\tPHASE_INFO=$(gsd_run query roadmap.get-phase \"${PHASE}\")\n237\t```\n238\t\n239\t**If `found` is false:** Error with available phases. **If `found` is true:** Extract `phase_number`, `phase_name`, `goal` from JSON.\n240\t\n241\tNow that `PHASE` is finalized, resolve MVP mode:\n242\t```bash\n243\tMVP_MODE=$(gsd_run query phase.mvp-mode \"${PHASE}\" $MVP_FLAG_ARG --pick active)\n244\t```\n245\t\n246\t## 3.5. Handle PRD Express Path\n247\t\n248\t**Skip if:** No `--prd` flag in arguments.\n249\t\n250\t**If `--prd <filepath>` provided:**\n251\t\n252\t1. Read the PRD file:\n253\t```bash\n254\tPRD_CONTENT=$(cat \"$PRD_FILE\" 2>/dev/null)\n255\tif [ -z \"$PRD_CONTENT\" ]; then\n256\t  echo \"Error: PRD file not found: $PRD_FILE\"\n257\t  exit 1\n258\tfi\n259\t```\n260\t\n261\t2. Display banner:\n262\t```\n263\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n264\t GSD ► PRD EXPRESS PATH\n265\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n266\t\n267\tUsing PRD: {PRD_FILE}\n268\tGenerating CONTEXT.md from requirements...\n269\t```\n270\t\n271\t3. Parse the PRD content and generate CONTEXT.md. The orchestrator should:\n272\t   - Extract all requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and constraints from the PRD\n273\t   - Map each to a locked decision (everything in the PRD is treated as a locked decision)\n274\t   - Identify any areas the PRD doesn't cover and mark as \"Claude's Discretion\"\n275\t   - **Extract canonical refs** from ROADMAP.md for this phase, plus any specs/ADRs referenced in the PRD — expand to full file paths (MANDATORY)\n276\t   - Create CONTEXT.md in the phase directory\n277\t\n278\t4. Write CONTEXT.md:\n279\t```markdown\n280\t# Phase [X]: [Name] - Context\n281\t\n282\t**Gathered:** [date]\n283\t**Status:** Ready for planning\n284\t**Source:** PRD Express Path ({PRD_FILE})\n285\t\n286\t<domain>\n287\t## Phase Boundary\n288\t\n289\t[Extracted from PRD — what this phase delivers]\n290\t\n291\t</domain>\n292\t\n293\t<decisions>\n294\t## Implementation Decisions\n295\t\n296\t{For each requirement/story/criterion in the PRD:}\n297\t### [Category derived from content]\n298\t- [Requirement as locked decision]\n299\t\n300\t### Claude's Discretion\n301\t[Areas not covered by PRD — implementation details, technical choices]\n302\t\n303\t</decisions>\n304\t\n305\t<canonical_refs>\n306\t## Canonical References\n307\t\n308\t**Downstream agents MUST read these before planning or implementing.**\n309\t\n310\t[MANDATORY. Extract from ROADMAP.md and any docs referenced in the PRD.\n311\tUse full relative paths. Group by topic area.]\n312\t\n313\t### [Topic area]\n314\t- `path/to/spec-or-adr.md` — [What it decides/defines]\n315\t\n316\t[If no external specs: \"No external specs — requirements fully captured in decisions above\"]\n317\t\n318\t</canonical_refs>\n319\t\n320\t<specifics>\n321\t## Specific Ideas\n322\t\n323\t[Any specific references, examples, or concrete requirements from PRD]\n324\t\n325\t</specifics>\n326\t\n327\t<deferred>\n328\t## Deferred Ideas\n329\t\n330\t[Items in PRD explicitly marked as future/v2/out-of-scope]\n331\t[If none: \"None — PRD covers phase scope\"]\n332\t\n333\t</deferred>\n334\t\n335\t---\n336\t\n337\t*Phase: XX-name*\n338\t*Context gathered: [date] via PRD Express Path*\n339\t```\n340\t\n341\t5. Commit:\n342\t```bash\n343\tgsd_run query commit \"docs(${padded_phase}): generate context from PRD\" --files \"${phase_dir}/${padded_phase}-CONTEXT.md\"\n344\t```\n345\t\n346\t6. Set `context_content` to the generated CONTEXT.md content and continue to step 5 (Handle Research).\n347\t\n348\t**Effect:** This completely bypasses step 4 (Load CONTEXT.md) since we just created it. The rest of the workflow (research, planning, verification) proceeds normally with the PRD-derived context.\n349\t\n350\t## 3.6. Handle ADR Ingest Express Path\n351\t\n352\t**Skip if:** No `--ingest` flag in arguments.\n353\t\n354\t**If `--ingest <path-or-glob>` provided:**\n355\t\n356\t1. Display banner: `GSD ► ADR Ingest Express Path` with `{INGEST_PATH}` and `{INGEST_FORMAT}`.\n357\t2. Parse each resolved ADR through `gsd-core/bin/lib/adr-parser.cjs` (`--input`, `--format`) and collect normalized records.\n358\t3. Status gate: reject `superseded`/`rejected`/`deprecated`; warn on `proposed`; missing status defaults to `accepted`.\n359\t4. Empty-decisions fallback: if all parsed ADRs have zero `decisions[]`, emit `ADR ingest produced no locked decisions; fall back to discuss-phase for this phase.` and exit with `/gsd-discuss-phase {N}` guidance.\n360\t5. Generate CONTEXT.md using `<domain>`, `<decisions>`, `<canonical_refs>`, `<specifics>`, `<deferred>`, `<scope_fence>`, map `consequences_positive[]` to Success Criteria and `consequences_negative[]` to Risk Summary, and include `**Source:** ADR Ingest Express Path ({INGEST_PATH})`.\n361\t6. Commit with `gsd-tools.cjs query commit \"docs(${padded_phase}): generate context from ADR ingest\" --files \"${phase_dir}/${padded_phase}-CONTEXT.md\"` and set `context_content`; continue to step 5.\n362\t\n363\t**Effect:** This bypasses step 4 (Load CONTEXT.md) since CONTEXT.md was synthesized from ADR input.\n364\t\n365\t## 4. Load CONTEXT.md\n366\t\n367\t**Skip if:** PRD express path or ADR ingest express path was used (CONTEXT.md already created in step 3.5/3.6).\n368\t\n369\tCheck `context_path` from init JSON.\n370\t\n371\tIf `context_path` is not null, display: `Using phase context from: ${context_path}`\n372\t\n373\t**If `context_path` is null (no CONTEXT.md exists):**\n374\t\n375\tRead discuss mode for context gate label:\n376\t```bash\n377\tDISCUSS_MODE=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.discuss_mode 2>/dev/null || echo \"discuss\")\n378\t```\n379\t\n380\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list:\n381\t```\n382\tNo CONTEXT.md found for Phase {X}. Plans will use research and requirements only — your design preferences won't be included.\n383\t\n384\t1. Continue without context — Plan using research + requirements only\n385\t[If DISCUSS_MODE is \"assumptions\":]\n386\t2. Gather context (assumptions mode) — Analyze codebase and surface assumptions before planning\n387\t[If DISCUSS_MODE is \"discuss\" or unset:]\n388\t2. Run discuss-phase first — Capture design decisions before planning\n389\t\n390\tEnter number:\n391\t```\n392\t\n393\tOtherwise use AskUserQuestion:\n394\t- header: \"No context\"\n395\t- question: \"No CONTEXT.md found for Phase {X}. Plans will use research and requirements only — your design preferences won't be included. Continue or capture context first?\"\n396\t- options:\n397\t  - \"Continue without context\" — Plan using research + requirements only\n398\t  If `DISCUSS_MODE` is `\"assumptions\"`:\n399\t  - \"Gather context (assumptions mode)\" — Analyze codebase and surface assumptions before planning\n400\t  If `DISCUSS_MODE` is `\"discuss\"` (or unset):\n401\t  - \"Run discuss-phase first\" — Capture design decisions before planning\n402\t\n403\tIf \"Continue without context\": Proceed to step 5.\n404\tIf \"Run discuss-phase first\":\n405\t  **IMPORTANT:** Do NOT invoke discuss-phase as a nested Skill/Task call — AskUserQuestion\n406\t  does not work correctly in nested subcontexts (#1009). Instead, display the command\n407\t  and exit so the user runs it as a top-level command:\n408\t  ```\n409\t  Run this command first, then re-run /gsd-plan-phase {X} ${GSD_WS}:\n410\t\n411\t  /gsd-discuss-phase {X} ${GSD_WS}\n412\t  ```\n413\t  **Exit the plan-phase workflow. Do not continue.**\n414\t\n415\t## 4.5. Resolve AI-SPEC Artifact\n416\t\n417\tAI integration activation is owned by the `ai-integration` capability's `plan:pre` step hook. The plan-phase host only discovers existing artifacts here so the planner can consume them; it must not read the capability's config key directly.\n418\t\n419\t```bash\n420\tAI_SPEC_FILE=$(ls \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-AI-SPEC.md 2>/dev/null | head -1)\n421\tAI_SPEC_PATH=\"${AI_SPEC_FILE}\"\n422\tFRAMEWORK_LINE=\"\"\n423\tif [ -n \"$AI_SPEC_FILE\" ]; then\n424\t  FRAMEWORK_LINE=$(grep \"Selected Framework:\" \"${AI_SPEC_FILE}\" | head -1)\n425\tfi\n426\t```\n427\t\n428\tIf `AI_SPEC_FILE` is non-empty, pass `AI_SPEC_PATH` and `FRAMEWORK_LINE` to the planner in step 8 so it can reference the AI design contract. If it is empty, the active `ai-integration` capability hook in step 5.6 handles any AI-system nudge or `/gsd-ai-integration-phase` dispatch.\n429\t\n430\t## 5. Handle Research\n431\t\n432\t**Skip if:** `--gaps` flag or `--skip-research` flag or `--reviews` flag.\n433\t\n434\t### 5.0. Research-Only Modifiers (`--view`, `--research`)\n435\t\n436\t**Skip if:** `RESEARCH_ONLY` is `false`.\n437\t\n438\tThree branches in research-only mode (`--research-phase <N>`):\n439\t\n440\t1. **`--view`**: print `RESEARCH.md` to stdout, no spawn, exit. If `RESEARCH.md` is missing, error with: `--view requires an existing RESEARCH.md; drop --view to spawn the researcher.`\n441\t2. **`--research`** (force-refresh): re-spawn researcher unconditionally — fall through to \"Spawn gsd-phase-researcher\" below.\n442\t3. **Neither flag AND `has_research=true`:** auto-use the existing research and exit cleanly — do not prompt, do not re-spawn. Emit `RESEARCH.md already exists for Phase ${PHASE}, using it. To force-refresh, re-invoke with --research; to print, re-invoke with --view. Path: ${research_path}` then exit. The explicit-flag escape hatches cover any deviation; this matches §5.1's promptless auto-use of existing research, removing the §5.0/§5.1 inconsistency (#159).\n443\t\n444\t```bash\n445\tif [[ \"$VIEW_ONLY\" == \"true\" ]]; then\n446\t  [[ -f \"$research_path\" ]] || { echo \"Error: --view requires an existing RESEARCH.md (Phase ${PHASE}). Drop --view to spawn the researcher.\"; exit 1; }\n447\t  cat \"$research_path\"; exit 0\n448\tfi\n449\t```\n450\t\n451\t### 5.1. Standard Research Decision\n452\t\n453\t**Skip if** `RESEARCH_ONLY=true` (the research-only mode in 5.0 already determined the path: spawn or exit). Without this guard, an LLM following the workflow could fall through into \"use existing, skip to step 6\" → planner spawn, violating the research-only contract. **CR #3045 finding: this gate makes the early-exit unreachable from any non-research-only branch.**\n454\t\n455\t**If `has_research` is true (from init) AND no `--research` flag:** Use existing, skip to step 6.\n456\t\n457\t**If RESEARCH.md missing OR `--research` flag:**\n458\t\n459\t**If no explicit flag (`--research` or `--skip-research`) and not `--auto`:**\n460\tAsk the user whether to research, with a contextual recommendation based on the phase:\n461\t\n462\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list:\n463\t```\n464\tResearch before planning Phase {X}: {phase_name}?\n465\t\n466\t1. Research first (Recommended) — Investigate domain, patterns, and dependencies before planning. Best for new features, unfamiliar integrations, or architectural changes.\n467\t2. Skip research — Plan directly from context and requirements. Best for bug fixes, simple refactors, or well-understood tasks.\n468\t\n469\tEnter number:\n470\t```\n471\t\n472\tOtherwise use AskUserQuestion:\n473\t```\n474\tAskUserQuestion([\n475\t  {\n476\t    question: \"Research before planning Phase {X}: {phase_name}?\",\n477\t    header: \"Research\",\n478\t    multiSelect: false,\n479\t    options: [\n480\t      { label: \"Research first (Recommended)\", description: \"Investigate domain, patterns, and dependencies before planning. Best for new features, unfamiliar integrations, or architectural changes.\" },\n481\t      { label: \"Skip research\", description: \"Plan directly from context and requirements. Best for bug fixes, simple refactors, or well-understood tasks.\" }\n482\t    ]\n483\t  }\n484\t])\n485\t```\n486\t\n487\tIf user selects \"Skip research\": skip to step 6.\n488\t\n489\t**If `--auto` and `research_enabled` is false:** Skip research silently (preserves automated behavior).\n490\t\n491\tDisplay banner:\n492\t```\n493\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n494\t GSD ► RESEARCHING PHASE {X}\n495\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n496\t\n497\t◆ Spawning researcher... (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n498\t```\n499\t\n500\t### Spawn gsd-phase-researcher\n501\t\n502\t```bash\n503\tif gsd_run query teams-status --active >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n504\t  echo \"⚠️  CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS detected. GSD's multi-agent orchestration is not validated under claude-code agent-teams and may stall (a subagent's completion can fail to route to the orchestrator). Recommend disabling agent-teams for GSD workflows. See https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/issues/1355\" >&2\n505\tfi\n506\t```\n507\t\n508\t```bash\n509\tPHASE_DESC=$(gsd_run query roadmap.get-phase \"${PHASE}\" --pick section)\n510\tif [ -z \"${PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON:-}\" ]; then\n511\t  PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON=$(gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw)\n512\tfi\n513\t```\n514\t\n515\tFind the active `research` step hook in `PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON`. Use the hook's `fragment.inline` as the prompt template and substitute the phase fields below before spawning its declared `ref.agent`.\n516\t\n517\t```markdown\n518\t{research_hook.fragment.inline}\n519\t```\n520\t\n521\t```\n522\tAgent(\n523\t  prompt=filled_research_hook_fragment,\n524\t  subagent_type=research_hook.ref.agent,\n525\t  model=\"{researcher_model}\",\n526\t  description=\"Research Phase {phase}\"\n527\t)\n528\t```\n529\t\n530\t> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Do not read more files, edit code, or run tests related to this task while the subagent is active. Wait for the subagent to return its result. This prevents duplicate work, conflicting edits, and wasted context. Only resume when the subagent result is available.\n531\t\n532\t### Handle Researcher Return\n533\t\n534\t- **`## RESEARCH COMPLETE`:** Display confirmation, continue to step 6\n535\t- **`## RESEARCH BLOCKED`:** Display blocker, offer: 1) Provide context, 2) Skip research, 3) Abort\n536\t\n537\t### Research-Only Early Exit (`--research-phase`)\n538\t\n539\t**Skip if:** `RESEARCH_ONLY` is `false` (the default).\n540\t\n541\t**If `RESEARCH_ONLY=true`:** the user invoked `/gsd-plan-phase --research-phase <N>` for research-only mode. Do **not** continue to Section 5.5+ (validation strategy, planner, plan-checker, verification, gaps, bounce, post-planning-gaps). Print the research-complete summary and exit cleanly:\n542\t\n543\t```text\n544\t✓ Research-only mode complete (#3042)\n545\t\n546\t  Phase:       ${PHASE}\n547\t  RESEARCH.md: ${research_path}\n548\t\n549\tRe-run /gsd-plan-phase ${PHASE} to plan the phase using this research,\n550\tor /gsd-plan-phase ${PHASE} --research to refresh research and plan.\n551\t```\n552\t\n553\tThis exits the workflow. The planner / plan-checker / verifier blocks below are skipped.\n554\t\n555\t## 5.5. Create Validation Strategy\n556\t\n557\tSkip if `nyquist_validation_enabled` is false OR `research_enabled` is false.\n558\t\n559\tIf `research_enabled` is false and `nyquist_validation_enabled` is true: warn \"Nyquist validation enabled but research disabled — VALIDATION.md cannot be created without RESEARCH.md. Plans will lack validation requirements (Dimension 8).\" Continue to step 6.\n560\t\n561\t**But Nyquist is not applicable for this run** when all of the following are true:\n562\t- `research_enabled` is false\n563\t- `has_research` is false\n564\t- no `--research` flag was provided\n565\t\n566\tIn that case: **skip validation-strategy creation entirely**. Do **not** expect `RESEARCH.md` or `VALIDATION.md` for this run, and continue to Step 6.\n567\t\n568\t```bash\n569\tgrep -l \"## Validation Architecture\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-RESEARCH.md 2>/dev/null || true\n570\t```\n571\t\n572\t**If found:**\n573\t1. Read template: `$HOME/.claude/gsd-core/templates/VALIDATION.md`\n574\t2. Write to `${PHASE_DIR}/${PADDED_PHASE}-VALIDATION.md` (use Write tool)\n575\t3. If `VALIDATION_CREATED=false`: STOP — do not proceed to Step 6\n581\t6. If `commit_docs`: `commit \"docs(phase-${PHASE}): add validation strategy\"`\n582\t\n583\t**If not found:** Warn and continue — plans may fail Dimension 8.\n584\t\n585\t## 5.55. Security Threat Model Gate\n586\t\n587\t> Capability-driven dispatch. Resolves active `plan:pre` hooks via the capability registry; the security hook's `when` condition is evaluated by the registry.\n588\t\n589\t```bash\n590\tPLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON=$(gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw)\n591\t```\n592\t\n593\tResolve active contribution hooks from `PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON` where `kind == \"contribution\"` and `capId == \"security\"`.\n594\t\n595\t**If no active security contribution hook exists:** Skip to step 5.6.\n596\t\n597\t**If an active security contribution hook exists:** Read `SECURITY_ASVS` from the active hook's `configValues.security_asvs_level` (default: `1`) and `SECURITY_BLOCK` from `configValues.security_block_on` (default: `\"high\"`). These values are resolved by the capability registry from user config using the same four-level precedence as hook activation — no inline `config-get` is needed.\n598\t\n599\tDisplay banner:\n600\t\n601\t```\n602\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n603\t GSD ► SECURITY THREAT MODEL REQUIRED (ASVS L{SECURITY_ASVS})\n604\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n605\t\n606\tEach PLAN.md must include a <threat_model> block.\n607\tBlock on: {SECURITY_BLOCK} severity threats.\n608\tOpt out: set security_enforcement: false in .planning/config.json\n609\t```\n610\t\n611\tContinue to step 5.6.
