Rules:\n931\t   - Every criterion must be checkable as a source assertion, behavior assertion, test command, or CLI output\n932\t   - NEVER use subjective language (\"looks correct\", \"properly configured\", \"consistent with\")\n933\t   - Include exact strings, patterns, values, command outputs, or observable behavior where that is the right proof\n934\t   - Examples:\n935\t     - Code: `auth.py contains def verify_token(` / `test_auth.py exits 0`\n936\t     - Behavior: `POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + httpOnly JWT cookie for valid credentials`\n937\t     - Config: `.env.example contains DATABASE_URL=` / `Dockerfile contains HEALTHCHECK`\n938\t     - Docs: `README.md contains '## Installation'` / `API.md lists all endpoints`\n939\t     - Infra: `deploy.yml has rollback step` / `docker-compose.yml has healthcheck for db`\n940\t\n941\t3. **`<action>`** — Must include CONCRETE values, not references. Rules:\n942\t   - NEVER say \"align X with Y\", \"match X to Y\", \"update to be consistent\" without specifying the exact target state\n943\t   - Include concrete identifiers and reference values: config keys, function signatures, SQL table names, class names, import paths, env vars, endpoint paths, etc.\n944\t   - If CONTEXT.md has a comparison table or expected values, copy only the target identifiers/values needed to remove ambiguity\n945\t   - Do not include full file contents, fenced code blocks, or complete implementations in `<action>`\n946\t   - The executor should understand the intended target state from `<action>` and use `<read_first>` files for current implementation details, patterns, and source-of-truth context\n947\t\n948\t**Why this matters:** Executor agents work from the plan text. Vague instructions like \"update the config to match production\" produce shallow one-line changes. Concrete instructions like \"add DATABASE_URL, set POOL_SIZE=20, add REDIS_URL, and read config/runtime.ts before editing\" produce complete work without turning the planner into the executor.\n949\t</deep_work_rules>\n950\t\n951\t<quality_gate>\n952\t- [ ] PLAN.md files created in phase directory\n953\t- [ ] Each plan has valid frontmatter\n954\t- [ ] Tasks are specific and actionable\n955\t- [ ] Every task has `<read_first>` with at least the file being modified\n956\t- [ ] Every task has `<acceptance_criteria>` with behavior, test-command, CLI, or source assertions\n957\t- [ ] Every `<action>` contains concrete identifiers without fenced code blocks or full implementations\n958\t- [ ] Dependencies correctly identified\n959\t- [ ] Waves assigned for parallel execution\n960\t- [ ] must_haves derived from phase goal\n961\t- [ ] Every PLAN.md includes an \"Artifacts this phase produces\" section listing symbols created by this phase (decorators, classes, functions, CLI flags, struct/dataclass fields, new file paths)\n962\t- [ ] Every SPEC ## Edge Coverage covered/backstop edge is represented in a plan's must_haves (no silent drops)\n963\t- [ ] Every SPEC ## Prohibitions resolved item is represented in a plan's must_haves.prohibitions (no silent drops)\n964\t</quality_gate>\n965\t```\n966\t\n967\t**If `CHUNKED_MODE` is `false` (default):** Spawn the planner as a single long-lived Agent:\n968\t\n969\t```text\n970\tAgent(\n971\t  prompt=filled_prompt,\n972\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n973\t  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n974\t  description=\"Plan Phase {phase}\"\n975\t)\n976\t```\n977\t\n978\t> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Chunked Planning Mode\n983\t\n984\t**Skip if `CHUNKED_MODE` is `false`.**\n985\t\n986\tChunked mode splits the single long-lived planner Agent run into a short outline Agent run followed by\n987\tN short per-plan Agent runs. Each run is bounded to ~3–5 min; each plan is committed individually\n988\tfor crash resilience. If any run hangs and the terminal is force-killed, rerunning\n989\t`/gsd-plan-phase {N} --chunked` resumes from the last successfully committed plan.\n990\t\n991\t**Intended for new or in-progress chunked runs.** To recover plans already written by a prior\n992\t*non-chunked* run, use step 6's \"Add more plans\" or proceed directly to `/gsd-execute-phase`\n993\t— don't start a fresh chunked run over existing non-chunked plans.\n994\t\n995\t### 8.5.1 Outline Phase (outline-only mode, ~2 min)\n996\t\n997\t**Resume detection:** If `${PHASE_DIR}/${PADDED_PHASE}-PLAN-OUTLINE.md` already exists **and\n998\tis valid** (contains the `## OUTLINE COMPLETE` marker), skip this sub-step — the outline\n999\talready exists from a previous run. Revision Loop (Max 3 Iterations)\n1295\t\n1296\tTrack `iteration_count` (starts at 1 after initial plan + check).\n1297\tTrack `prev_issue_count` (initialized to `Infinity` before the loop begins).\n1298\tTrack `stall_reentry_count` (starts at 0; incremented each time \"Adjust approach\" re-enters step 8).\n1299\t\n1300\t**If iteration_count < 3:**\n1301\t\n1302\tParse issue count from checker return: count BLOCKER + WARNING entries in the YAML issues block (structured output from gsd-plan-checker). Proceed to step 13.\n1303\t\n1304\tDisplay: `Revision iteration {N}/3 -- {blocker_count} blockers, {warning_count} warnings`\n1305\t\n1306\t**Stall detection:** If `issue_count >= prev_issue_count`:\n1307\t  Display: `Revision loop stalled — issue count not decreasing ({issue_count} issues remain after {N} iterations)`\n1308\t\n1309\t  **If `stall_reentry_count < 2`:**\n1310\t    Ask user:\n1311\t      Question: \"Issues remain after {N} revision attempts with no progress. Proceed with current output?\"\n1312\t      Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Adjust approach\"\n1313\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1314\t    If \"Adjust approach\": increment `stall_reentry_count`, open freeform discussion, then re-enter step 8 (full replanning). Note: re-entry resets `iteration_count` and `prev_issue_count` but `stall_reentry_count` persists across re-entries and is capped at 2.\n1315\t\n1316\t  **If `stall_reentry_count >= 2`:**\n1317\t    Display: `Stall persists after 2 re-planning attempts. The following issues could not be resolved automatically:`\n1318\t    List the remaining issues from the checker.\n1319\t    Suggest: \"Consider resolving these issues manually or running `/gsd-debug` to investigate root causes.\"\n1320\t    Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Abandon\"\n1321\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1322\t    If \"Abandon\": stop workflow.\n1323\t\n1324\tSet `prev_issue_count = issue_count`.\n1325\t\n1326\tRevision prompt:\n1327\t\n1328\t```markdown\n1329\t<revision_context>\n1330\t**Phase:** {phase_number}\n1331\t**Mode:** revision\n1332\t\n1333\t<files_to_read>\n1334\t- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Existing plans)\n1335\t- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n1336\t</files_to_read>\n1337\t\n1338\t${AGENT_SKILLS_PLANNER}\n1339\t\n1340\t**Checker issues:** {structured_issues_from_checker}\n1341\t</revision_context>\n1342\t\n1343\t<instructions>\n1344\tMake targeted updates to address checker issues.\n1345\tDo NOT replan from scratch unless issues are fundamental.\n1346\tReturn what changed.\n1347\t</instructions>\n1348\t```\n1349\t\n1350\t```\n1351\tAgent(\n1352\t  prompt=revision_prompt,\n1353\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n1354\t  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n1355\t  description=\"Revise Phase {phase} plans\"\n1356\t)\n1357\t```\n1358\t\n1359\t> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Do not read more files, edit code, or run tests related to this task while the subagent is active. Wait for the subagent to return its result. This prevents duplicate work, conflicting edits, and wasted context. Only resume when the subagent result is available.\n1360\t\n1361\tAfter planner returns -> spawn checker again (step 10), increment iteration_count.\n1362\t\n1363\t**If iteration_count >= 3:**\n1364\t\n1365\tDisplay: `Max iterations reached. {N} issues remain:` + issue list\n1366\t\n1367\tOffer: 1) Force proceed, 2) Provide guidance and retry, 3) Abandon\n1368\t\n1369\t## 12.5. Plan Bounce (Optional External Refinement)\n1370\t\n1371\t**Skip if:** `--skip-bounce` flag, `--gaps` flag, or bounce is not activated.\n1372\t\n1373\t**Activation:** Bounce runs when `--bounce` flag is present OR `workflow.plan_bounce` config is `true`. The `--skip-bounce` flag always wins (disables bounce even if config enables it). The `--gaps` flag also disables bounce (gap-closure mode should not modify plans externally).\n1374\t\n1375\t**Prerequisites:** `workflow.plan_bounce_script` must be set to a valid script path. If bounce is activated but no script is configured, display warning and skip:\n1376\t```\n1377\t⚠ Plan bounce activated but no script configured.\n1378\tSet workflow.plan_bounce_script to the path of your refinement script.\n1379\tSkipping bounce step.\n1380\t```\n1381\t\n1382\t**Read pass count:**\n1383\t```bash\n1384\tBOUNCE_PASSES=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_passes 2>/dev/null || echo \"2\")\n1385\tBOUNCE_SCRIPT=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_script 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.' 2>/dev/null || true)\n1386\t```\n1387\t\n1388\tDisplay banner:\n1389\t```\n1390\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1391\t GSD ► BOUNCING PLANS (External Refinement)\n1392\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1393\t\n1394\tScript: ${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\n1395\tMax passes: ${BOUNCE_PASSES}\n1396\t```\n1397\t\n1398\t**For each PLAN.md file in the phase directory:**\n1399\t\n1400\t1. **Backup:** Copy `*-PLAN.md` to `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md`\n1401\t```bash\n1402\tcp \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${PLAN_FILE%.md}.pre-bounce.md\"\n1403\t```\n1404\t\n1405\t2. **Invoke bounce script:**\n1406\t```bash\n1407\t\"${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\" \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${BOUNCE_PASSES}\"\n1408\t```\n1409\t\n1410\t3. **Validate bounced plan — YAML frontmatter integrity:**\n1411\tAfter the script returns, check that the bounced file still has valid YAML frontmatter (opening and closing `---` delimiters with parseable content between them). If the bounced plan breaks YAML frontmatter validation, restore the original from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n1412\t```\n1413\t⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} has broken YAML frontmatter — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1414\t```\n1415\t\n1416\t4. **Handle script failure:** If the bounce script exits non-zero, restore the original plan from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n1417\t```\n1418\t⚠ Bounce script failed for ${PLAN_FILE} (exit code ${EXIT_CODE}) — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1419\t```\n1420\t\n1421\t**After all plans are bounced:**\n1422\t\n1423\t5. **Re-run plan checker on bounced plans:** Spawn gsd-plan-checker (same as step 10) on all modified plans. If a bounced plan fails the checker, restore original from its pre-bounce.md backup:\n1424\t```\n1425\t⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} failed checker validation — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n1426\t```\n1427\t\n1428\t6. **Commit surviving bounced plans:** If at least one plan survived both the frontmatter validation and the checker re-run, commit the changes:\n1429\t```bash\n1430\tgsd_run query commit \"refactor(${padded_phase}): bounce plans through external refinement\" --files \"${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md\"\n1431\t```\n1432\t\n1433\tDisplay summary:\n1434\t```\n1435\tPlan bounce complete: {survived}/{total} plans refined\n1436\t```\n1437\t\n1438\t**Clean up:** Remove all `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md` backup files after the bounce step completes (whether plans survived or were restored).\n1439\t\n1440\t## 13. Requirements Coverage Gate\n1441\t\n1442\tAfter plans pass the checker (or checker is skipped), verify that all phase requirements are covered by at least one plan.\n1443\t\n1444\t**Skip if:** `phase_req_ids` is null or TBD (no requirements mapped to this phase).\n1445\t\n1446\t**Step 1: Extract requirement IDs claimed by plans**\n1447\t```bash\n1448\t# Collect all requirement IDs from plan frontmatter\n1449\tPLAN_REQS=$(grep -h \"requirements_addressed\\|requirements:\" ${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u)\n1450\t```\n1451\t\n1452\t**Step 2: Compare against phase requirements from ROADMAP**\n1453\t\n1454\tFor each REQ-ID in `phase_req_ids`:\n1455\t- If REQ-ID appears in `PLAN_REQS` → covered ✓\n1456\t- If REQ-ID does NOT appear in any plan → uncovered ✗\n1457\t\n1458\t**Step 3: Check CONTEXT.md features against plan objectives**\n1459\t\n1460\tRead CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` section. Extract feature/capability names. Check each against plan `<objective>` blocks. Features not mentioned in any plan objective → potentially dropped.\n1461\t\n1462\t**Step 4: Report**\n1463\t\n1464\tIf all requirements covered and no dropped features:\n1465\t```\n1466\t✓ Requirements coverage: {N}/{N} REQ-IDs covered by plans\n1467\t```\n1468\t→ Proceed to step 14.\n1469\t\n1470\tIf gaps found:\n1471\t```\n1472\t## ⚠ Requirements Coverage Gap\n1473\t\n1474\t{M} of {N} phase requirements are not assigned to any plan:\n1475\t\n1476\t| REQ-ID | Description | Plans |\n1477\t|--------|-------------|-------|\n1478\t| {id} | {from REQUIREMENTS.md} | None |\n1479\t\n1480\t{K} CONTEXT.md features not found in plan objectives:\n1481\t- {feature_name} — described in CONTEXT.md but no plan covers it\n1482\t\n1483\tOptions:\n1484\t1. Re-plan to include missing requirements (recommended)\n1485\t2. Move uncovered requirements to next phase\n1486\t3. Proceed anyway — accept coverage gaps\n1487\t```\n1488\t\n1489\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list (options already shown in the block above). Otherwise use AskUserQuestion to present the options.\n1490\t\n1491\t## 13a. Decision Coverage Gate\n1492\t\n1493\tAfter the requirements coverage gate passes, verify that every trackable\n1494\tdecision captured by discuss-phase in CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` is referenced\n1495\tby at least one plan. This is the **translation gate** from issue #2492 —\n1496\tits job is to refuse to mark a phase planned when a discuss-phase decision\n1497\tsilently dropped on the way into the plans.\n1498\t\n1499\t**Skip if** `workflow.context_coverage_gate` is explicitly set to `false`\n1500\t(absent key = enabled). Also skip if no CONTEXT.md exists for this phase\n1501\t(nothing to translate) or if its `<decisions>` block is empty.\n1502\t\n1503\t```bash\n1504\tGATE_CFG=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.context_coverage_gate 2>/dev/null || echo \"true\")\n1505\tif [ \"$GATE_CFG\" != \"false\" ]; then\n1506\t  GATE_RESULT=$(gsd_run query check.decision-coverage-plan \"${PHASE_DIR}\" \"${CONTEXT_PATH}\")\n1507\t  # BLOCKING: refuse to mark phase planned when a trackable decision is uncovered.\n1508\t  # `passed: true` covers both real-pass and skipped cases (gate disabled / no CONTEXT.md /\n1509\t  # no trackable decisions). Verify-phase counterpart deliberately omits this exit-1 — that\n1510\t  # gate is non-blocking by design (review finding F15).\n1511\t  echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -e '(.passed // .data.passed) == true' >/dev/null || {\n1512\t    echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -r '(.message // .data.message // \"Decision coverage gate failed.\")'\n1513\t    exit 1\n1514\t  }\n1515\tfi\n1516\t```\n1517\t\n1518\tThe handler returns JSON:\n1519\t```json\n1520\t{\n1521\t  \"passed\": true,\n1522\t  \"skipped\": false,\n1523\t  \"total\":  2,\n1524\t  \"covered\": 2,\n1525\t  \"uncovered\": [ { \"id\": \"D-01\", \"text\": \"...\", \"category\": \"...\" } ],\n1526\t  \"message\": \"...\"\n1527\t}\n1528\t```\n1529\t\n1530\t**If `passed` is true (or `skipped` is true):** Display\n1531\t`✓ Decision coverage: {M}/{N} CONTEXT.md decisions covered by plans` (or\n1532\t`(skipped — gate disabled)` / `(skipped — no decisions)`) and proceed to\n1533\tstep 13b.\n1534\t\n1535\t**If `passed` is false:** Display the handler's `message` block. It already\n1536\tnames each uncovered decision (`D-NN | category | text`) and tells the user\n1537\twhat to do — cite the id in a relevant plan's `must_haves` / `truths`, or\n1538\tmove the decision under `### Claude's Discretion` / tag it `[informational]`\n1539\tif it should not be tracked. Then offer:\n1540\t\n1541\t```text\n1542\tOptions:\n1543\t1. Re-plan to cover missing decisions (recommended)\n1544\t2. Edit CONTEXT.md to mark dropped decisions as [informational] / Discretion\n1545\t3. Proceed anyway — accept the coverage gap\n1546\t```\n1547\t\n1548\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list. Otherwise use\n1549\tAskUserQuestion. Selecting \"Proceed anyway\" continues to step 13b but\n1550\trecords the override in STATE.md so verify-phase can re-surface it.\n1551\t\n1552\t**Why this gate blocks:** failing here is cheap. The plans are the contract\n1553\tbetween discuss-phase and execute-phase; if a decision isn't visible in any\n1554\tplan, no executor will implement it. Catching that now beats discovering it\n1555\tafter thousands of dollars of execution.\n1556\t\n1557\t## 13b. Display banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► PRD EXPRESS PATH\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\nUsing PRD: {PRD_FILE}\nGenerating CONTEXT.md from requirements...\n```\n\n3. Parse the PRD content and generate CONTEXT.md. The orchestrator should:\n   - Extract all requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and constraints from the PRD\n   - Map each to a locked decision (everything in the PRD is treated as a locked decision)\n   - Identify any areas the PRD doesn't cover and mark as \"Claude's Discretion\"\n   - **Extract canonical refs** from ROADMAP.md for this phase, plus any specs/ADRs referenced in the PRD — expand to full file paths (MANDATORY)\n   - Create CONTEXT.md in the phase directory\n\n4. Write CONTEXT.md:\n```markdown\n# Phase [X]: [Name] - Context\n\n**Gathered:** [date]\n**Status:** Ready for planning\n**Source:** PRD Express Path ({PRD_FILE})\n\n<domain>\n## Phase Boundary\n\n[Extracted from PRD — what this phase delivers]\n\n</domain>\n\n<decisions>\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n{For each requirement/story/criterion in the PRD:}\n### [Category derived from content]\n- [Requirement as locked decision]\n\n### Claude's Discretion\n[Areas not covered by PRD — implementation details, technical choices]\n\n</decisions>\n\n<canonical_refs>\n## Canonical References\n\n**Downstream agents MUST read these before planning or implementing.**\n\n[MANDATORY. Extract from ROADMAP.md and any docs referenced in the PRD.\nUse full relative paths. Group by topic area.]\n\n### [Topic area]\n- `path/to/spec-or-adr.md` — [What it decides/defines]\n\n[If no external specs: \"No external specs — requirements fully captured in decisions above\"]\n\n</canonical_refs>\n\n<specifics>\n## Specific Ideas\n\n[Any specific references, examples, or concrete requirements from PRD]\n\n</specifics>\n\n<deferred>\n## Deferred Ideas\n\n[Items in PRD explicitly marked as future/v2/out-of-scope]\n[If none: \"None — PRD covers phase scope\"]\n\n</deferred>\n\n---\n\n*Phase: XX-name*\n*Context gathered: [date] via PRD Express Path*\n```\n\n5. Commit:\n```bash\ngsd_run query commit \"docs(${padded_phase}): generate context from PRD\" --files \"${phase_dir}/${padded_phase}-CONTEXT.md\"\n```\n\n6. Set `context_content` to the generated CONTEXT.md content and continue to step 5 (Handle Research).\n\n**Effect:** This completely bypasses step 4 (Load CONTEXT.md) since we just created it. The rest of the workflow (research, planning, verification) proceeds normally with the PRD-derived context.\n\n## 3.6. Handle ADR Ingest Express Path\n\n**Skip if:** No `--ingest` flag in arguments.\n\n**If `--ingest <path-or-glob>` provided:**\n\n1. Display banner: `GSD ► ADR Ingest Express Path` with `{INGEST_PATH}` and `{INGEST_FORMAT}`.\n2. Parse each resolved ADR through `gsd-core/bin/lib/adr-parser.cjs` (`--input`, `--format`) and collect normalized records.\n3. Status gate: reject `superseded`/`rejected`/`deprecated`; warn on `proposed`; missing status defaults to `accepted`.\n4. Empty-decisions fallback: if all parsed ADRs have zero `decisions[]`, emit `ADR ingest produced no locked decisions; fall back to discuss-phase for this phase.` and exit with `/gsd-discuss-phase {N}` guidance.\n5. Generate CONTEXT.md using `<domain>`, `<decisions>`, `<canonical_refs>`, `<specifics>`, `<deferred>`, `<scope_fence>`, map `consequences_positive[]` to Success Criteria and `consequences_negative[]` to Risk Summary, and include `**Source:** ADR Ingest Express Path ({INGEST_PATH})`.\n6. Commit with `gsd-tools.cjs query commit \"docs(${padded_phase}): generate context from ADR ingest\" --files \"${phase_dir}/${padded_phase}-CONTEXT.md\"` and set `context_content`; continue to step 5.\n\n**Effect:** This bypasses step 4 (Load CONTEXT.md) since CONTEXT.md was synthesized from ADR input.\n\n## 4. Continue without context — Plan using research + requirements only\n[If DISCUSS_MODE is \"assumptions\":]\n2. Gather context (assumptions mode) — Analyze codebase and surface assumptions before planning\n[If DISCUSS_MODE is \"discuss\" or unset:]\n2. Run discuss-phase first — Capture design decisions before planning\n\nEnter number:\n```\n\nOtherwise use AskUserQuestion:\n- header: \"No context\"\n- question: \"No CONTEXT.md found for Phase {X}. Plans will use research and requirements only — your design preferences won't be included. Continue or capture context first?\"\n- options:\n  - \"Continue without context\" — Plan using research + requirements only\n  If `DISCUSS_MODE` is `\"assumptions\"`:\n  - \"Gather context (assumptions mode)\" — Analyze codebase and surface assumptions before planning\n  If `DISCUSS_MODE` is `\"discuss\"` (or unset):\n  - \"Run discuss-phase first\" — Capture design decisions before planning\n\nIf \"Continue without context\": Proceed to step 5.\nIf \"Run discuss-phase first\":\n  **IMPORTANT:** Do NOT invoke discuss-phase as a nested Skill/Task call — AskUserQuestion\n  does not work correctly in nested subcontexts (#1009). Instead, display the command\n  and exit so the user runs it as a top-level command:\n  ```\n  Run this command first, then re-run /gsd-plan-phase {X} ${GSD_WS}:\n\n  /gsd-discuss-phase {X} ${GSD_WS}\n  ```\n  **Exit the plan-phase workflow. Do not continue.**\n\n## 4.5. Resolve AI-SPEC Artifact\n\nAI integration activation is owned by the `ai-integration` capability's `plan:pre` step hook. Handle Research\n\n**Skip if:** `--gaps` flag or `--skip-research` flag or `--reviews` flag.\n\n### 5.0. Research-Only Modifiers (`--view`, `--research`)\n\n**Skip if:** `RESEARCH_ONLY` is `false`.\n\nThree branches in research-only mode (`--research-phase <N>`):\n\n1. **`--view`**: print `RESEARCH.md` to stdout, no spawn, exit. If `RESEARCH.md` is missing, error with: `--view requires an existing RESEARCH.md; drop --view to spawn the researcher.`\n2. **`--research`** (force-refresh): re-spawn researcher unconditionally — fall through to \"Spawn gsd-phase-researcher\" below.\n3. **Neither flag AND `has_research=true`:** auto-use the existing research and exit cleanly — do not prompt, do not re-spawn. Emit `RESEARCH.md already exists for Phase ${PHASE}, using it. To force-refresh, re-invoke with --research; to print, re-invoke with --view. Path: ${research_path}` then exit. The explicit-flag escape hatches cover any deviation; this matches §5.1's promptless auto-use of existing research, removing the §5.0/§5.1 inconsistency (#159).\n\n```bash\nif [[ \"$VIEW_ONLY\" == \"true\" ]]; then\n  [[ -f \"$research_path\" ]] || { echo \"Error: --view requires an existing RESEARCH.md (Phase ${PHASE}). Drop --view to spawn the researcher.\"; exit 1; }\n  cat \"$research_path\"; exit 0\nfi\n```\n\n### 5.1. Standard Research Decision\n\n**Skip if** `RESEARCH_ONLY=true` (the research-only mode in 5.0 already determined the path: spawn or exit). Without this guard, an LLM following the workflow could fall through into \"use existing, skip to step 6\" → planner spawn, violating the research-only contract. **CR #3045 finding: this gate makes the early-exit unreachable from any non-research-only branch.**\n\n**If `has_research` is true (from init) AND no `--research` flag:** Use existing, skip to step 6.\n\n**If RESEARCH.md missing OR `--research` flag:**\n\n**If no explicit flag (`--research` or `--skip-research`) and not `--auto`:**\nAsk the user whether to research, with a contextual recommendation based on the phase:\n\nIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list:\n```\nResearch before planning Phase {X}: {phase_name}?\n\n1. (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n```\n\n### Spawn gsd-phase-researcher\n\n```bash\nif gsd_run query teams-status --active >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n  echo \"⚠️  CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS detected. Rules:\n   - Every criterion must be checkable as a source assertion, behavior assertion, test command, or CLI output\n   - NEVER use subjective language (\"looks correct\", \"properly configured\", \"consistent with\")\n   - Include exact strings, patterns, values, command outputs, or observable behavior where that is the right proof\n   - Examples:\n     - Code: `auth.py contains def verify_token(` / `test_auth.py exits 0`\n     - Behavior: `POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + httpOnly JWT cookie for valid credentials`\n     - Config: `.env.example contains DATABASE_URL=` / `Dockerfile contains HEALTHCHECK`\n     - Docs: `README.md contains '## Installation'` / `API.md lists all endpoints`\n     - Infra: `deploy.yml has rollback step` / `docker-compose.yml has healthcheck for db`\n\n3. **`<action>`** — Must include CONCRETE values, not references. Chunked Planning Mode\n\n**Skip if `CHUNKED_MODE` is `false`.**\n\nChunked mode splits the single long-lived planner Agent run into a short outline Agent run followed by\nN short per-plan Agent runs. Each run is bounded to ~3–5 min; each plan is committed individually\nfor crash resilience. If any run hangs and the terminal is force-killed, rerunning\n`/gsd-plan-phase {N} --chunked` resumes from the last successfully committed plan.\n\n**Intended for new or in-progress chunked runs.** To recover plans already written by a prior\n*non-chunked* run, use step 6's \"Add more plans\" or proceed directly to `/gsd-execute-phase`\n— don't start a fresh chunked run over existing non-chunked plans.\n\n### 8.5.1 Outline Phase (outline-only mode, ~2 min)\n\n**Resume detection:** If `${PHASE_DIR}/${PADDED_PHASE}-PLAN-OUTLINE.md` already exists **and\nis valid** (contains the `## OUTLINE COMPLETE` marker), skip this sub-step — the outline\nalready exists from a previous run. (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n```\n\nSpawn the planner in **outline-only** mode — it must write only the outline manifest, not any\nPLAN.md files:\n\n```javascript\nAgent(\n  prompt=\"{same planning_context as step 8, plus:}\n\n  **Chunked mode: outline-only.**\n  Do NOT write any PLAN.md files in this Task.\n  Write only: {PHASE_DIR}/{PADDED_PHASE}-PLAN-OUTLINE.md\n\n  The outline must be a markdown table with columns:\n  Plan ID | Objective | Wave | Depends On | Requirements\n\n  Return: ## OUTLINE COMPLETE with plan count.\",\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n  description=\"Outline Phase {phase} (chunked)\"\n)\n```\n\n> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Do not read more files, edit code, or run tests related to this task while the subagent is active. Wait for the subagent to return its result. Filesystem Fallback (Planner)\n\n**Triggered when:** Agent() returns but the return contains no recognized marker (`## PLANNING COMPLETE`, `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, `## ⚠ Source Audit`, `## CHECKPOINT REACHED`, `## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE`).\n\n```bash\nDISK_PLANS=$(ls \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\n```\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** The planner wrote plans to disk but the Agent() return was empty or\ntruncated (the Windows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never\narrived). Display:\n\n```text\n◆ Planner wrote {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) to disk but did not emit a PLANNING COMPLETE marker.\n  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — work is likely recoverable.\n\n  Plans found on disk:\n  {ls output of *-PLAN.md}\n```\n\nOffer 3 options:\n1. **Accept plans** — treat as `## PLANNING COMPLETE` and continue through step 9 `## PLANNING COMPLETE` handling (so `--skip-verify` / `plan_checker_enabled=false` are honored — may skip to step 13 rather than step 10)\n2. **Retry planner** — re-spawn the planner with the same prompt (return to step 8)\n3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0 and no marker:** The planner produced no output. Treat as\n`## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE` and handle accordingly.\n\n## 9b. Handle Phase Split Recommendation\n\nWhen the planner returns `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, it means the phase's source items exceed the context budget for full-fidelity implementation. The planner proposes groupings.\n\n**Extract from planner return:**\n- Proposed sub-phases (e.g., \"17a: processing core (D-01 to D-19)\", \"17b: billing + config UX (D-20 to D-27)\")\n- Which source items (REQ-IDs, D-XX decisions, RESEARCH items) go in each sub-phase\n- Why the split is necessary (context cost estimate, file count)\n\n**Present to user:**\n```\n## Phase {X} exceeds context budget for full-fidelity implementation\n\nThe planner found {N} source items that exceed the context budget when\nplanned at full fidelity. Instead of reducing scope, we recommend splitting:\n\n**Option 1: Split into sub-phases**\n- Phase {X}a: {name} — {items} ({N} source items, ~{P}% context)\n- Phase {X}b: {name} — {items} ({M} source items, ~{Q}% context)\n\n**Option 2: Proceed anyway** (planner will attempt all, quality may degrade past 50% context)\n\n**Option 3: Prioritize** — you choose which items to implement now,\nrest become a follow-up phase\n```\n\nUse AskUserQuestion with these 3 options.\n\n**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` to create the sub-phases, then replan each.\n**If \"Proceed\":** Return to planner with instruction to attempt all items at full fidelity, accepting more plans/tasks.\n**If \"Prioritize\":** Use AskUserQuestion (multiSelect) to let user pick which items are \"now\" vs \"later\". Create CONTEXT.md for each sub-phase with the selected items.\n\n## 9c. Handle Source Audit Gaps\n\nWhen the planner returns `## ⚠ Source Audit: Unplanned Items Found`, it means items from REQUIREMENTS.md, RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP goal, or CONTEXT.md decisions have no corresponding plan.\n\n**Extract from planner return:**\n- Each unplanned item with its source artifact and section\n- The planner's suggested options (A: add plan, B: split phase, C: defer with confirmation)\n\n**Present each gap to user.** For each unplanned item:\n\n```\n## ⚠ Unplanned: {item description}\n\nSource: {RESEARCH.md / REQUIREMENTS.md / ROADMAP goal / CONTEXT.md}\nDetails: {why the planner flagged this}\n\nOptions:\n1. Add a plan to cover this item (recommended)\n2. Split phase — move to a sub-phase with related items\n3. Defer — add to backlog (developer confirms this is intentional)\n```\n\nUse AskUserQuestion for each gap (or batch if multiple gaps).\n\n**If \"Add plan\":** Return to planner (step 8) with instruction to add plans covering the missing items, preserving existing plans.\n**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` for overflow items, then replan.\n**If \"Defer\":** Record in CONTEXT.md `## Deferred Ideas` with developer's confirmation. Proceed to step 10.\n\n## 10. Spawn gsd-plan-checker Agent\n\nDisplay banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► VERIFYING PLANS\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n◆ Spawning plan checker... (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n```\n\nChecker prompt:\n\n```markdown\n<verification_context>\n**Phase:** {phase_number}\n**Phase Goal:** {goal from ROADMAP}\n**Mode:** {standard | gap_closure | reviews}\n\n<files_to_read>\n- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Plans to verify)\n- {roadmap_path} (Roadmap)\n- {requirements_path} (Requirements)\n- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n- {research_path} (Technical Research — includes Validation Architecture)\n- {reviews_path} (Cross-AI Review Feedback - if --reviews; verify actionable findings are represented in PLAN.md)\n</files_to_read>\n\n${AGENT_SKILLS_CHECKER}\n\n<review_incorporation_verification>\n**If Mode is reviews:** Read REVIEWS.md and verify each current actionable review finding is visible in executable PLAN.md content or explicitly deferred/rejected in the relevant PLAN.md. A finding remains actionable if it requires a concrete plan task, `<action>`, `<acceptance_criteria>`, `<verify>`, `must_haves`, threat-model item, stale-path correction, or execution contract change before /gsd-execute-phase runs.\n\nIf an actionable finding remains only in REVIEWS.md and would be invisible to /gsd-execute-phase, return `## ISSUES FOUND`. Use WARNING by default; use BLOCKER when the missing incorporation can prevent the phase goal, create unsafe execution, or invalidate verification.\n</review_incorporation_verification>\n\n**Phase requirement IDs (MUST ALL be covered):** {phase_req_ids}\n\n**Project instructions:** Read ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md if either exists — verify plans honor project guidelines\n**Project skills:** Check .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/ directory (if either exists) — verify plans account for project skill rules\n</verification_context>\n\n<expected_output>\n- ## VERIFICATION PASSED — all checks pass\n- ## ISSUES FOUND — structured issue list\n</expected_output>\n```\n\n```\nAgent(\n  prompt=checker_prompt,\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-plan-checker\",\n  model=\"{checker_model}\",\n  description=\"Verify Phase {phase} plans\"\n)\n```\n\n> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Do not read more files, edit code, or run tests related to this task while the subagent is active. Wait for the subagent to return its result. This prevents duplicate work, conflicting edits, and wasted context. Only resume when the subagent result is available.\n\n## 11. Handle Checker Return\n\n- **`## VERIFICATION PASSED`:** Display confirmation, proceed to step 13.\n- **`## ISSUES FOUND`:** Display issues, check iteration count, proceed to step 12.\n- **Empty / truncated / no recognized marker:** → Filesystem fallback (step 11a).\n\n**Thinking partner for architectural tradeoffs (conditional):**\nIf `features.thinking_partner` is enabled, scan the checker's issues for architectural tradeoff keywords\n(\"architecture\", \"approach\", \"strategy\", \"pattern\", \"vs\", \"alternative\"). If found:\n\n```\nThe plan-checker flagged an architectural decision point:\n{issue description}\n\nBrief analysis:\n- Option A: {approach_from_plan} — {pros/cons}\n- Option B: {alternative_approach} — {pros/cons}\n- Recommendation: {choice} aligned with {phase_goal}\n\nApply this to the revision? [Yes] / [No, I'll decide]\n```\n\nIf yes: include the recommendation in the revision prompt. If no: proceed to revision loop as normal.\nIf thinking_partner disabled: skip this block entirely.\n\n## 11a. Filesystem Fallback (Checker)\n\n**Triggered when:** Checker Agent() returns but the return contains neither `## VERIFICATION PASSED` nor `## ISSUES FOUND`.\n\n```bash\nDISK_PLANS=$(ls \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\n```\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** Plans exist on disk; the checker return was empty or truncated (the\nWindows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never arrived). Display:\n\n```text\n◆ Checker return was empty or truncated. {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) exist on disk.\n  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — checker may have completed without returning.\n```\n\nOffer 3 options:\n1. **Accept verification** — treat as `## VERIFICATION PASSED` and continue to step 13\n2. **Retry checker** — re-spawn the checker with the same prompt (return to step 10)\n3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n\n**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0:** No plans on disk — something is seriously wrong. Display error and stop.\n\n## 12. Revision Loop (Max 3 Iterations)\n\nTrack `iteration_count` (starts at 1 after initial plan + check).\nTrack `prev_issue_count` (initialized to `Infinity` before the loop begins).\nTrack `stall_reentry_count` (starts at 0; incremented each time \"Adjust approach\" re-enters step 8).\n\n**If iteration_count < 3:**\n\nParse issue count from checker return: count BLOCKER + WARNING entries in the YAML issues block (structured output from gsd-plan-checker). If the checker's return contains no YAML issues block (i.e., the plan was approved with no issues), treat `issue_count` as 0 and skip the stall check — the plan passed. Proceed to step 13.\n\nDisplay: `Revision iteration {N}/3 -- {blocker_count} blockers, {warning_count} warnings`\n\n**Stall detection:** If `issue_count >= prev_issue_count`:\n  Display: `Revision loop stalled — issue count not decreasing ({issue_count} issues remain after {N} iterations)`\n\n  **If `stall_reentry_count < 2`:**\n    Ask user:\n      Question: \"Issues remain after {N} revision attempts with no progress. Proceed with current output?\"\n      Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Adjust approach\"\n    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n    If \"Adjust approach\": increment `stall_reentry_count`, open freeform discussion, then re-enter step 8 (full replanning). Note: re-entry resets `iteration_count` and `prev_issue_count` but `stall_reentry_count` persists across re-entries and is capped at 2.\n\n  **If `stall_reentry_count >= 2`:**\n    Display: `Stall persists after 2 re-planning attempts. The following issues could not be resolved automatically:`\n    List the remaining issues from the checker.\n    Suggest: \"Consider resolving these issues manually or running `/gsd-debug` to investigate root causes.\"\n    Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Abandon\"\n    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n    If \"Abandon\": stop workflow.\n\nSet `prev_issue_count = issue_count`.\n\nRevision prompt:\n\n```markdown\n<revision_context>\n**Phase:** {phase_number}\n**Mode:** revision\n\n<files_to_read>\n- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Existing plans)\n- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n</files_to_read>\n\n${AGENT_SKILLS_PLANNER}\n\n**Checker issues:** {structured_issues_from_checker}\n</revision_context>\n\n<instructions>\nMake targeted updates to address checker issues.\nDo NOT replan from scratch unless issues are fundamental.\nReturn what changed.\n</instructions>\n```\n\n```\nAgent(\n  prompt=revision_prompt,\n  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n  description=\"Revise Phase {phase} plans\"\n)\n```\n\n> **ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES**: After calling Agent() above, stop working on this task immediately. Do not read more files, edit code, or run tests related to this task while the subagent is active. Wait for the subagent to return its result. This prevents duplicate work, conflicting edits, and wasted context. Only resume when the subagent result is available.\n\nAfter planner returns -> spawn checker again (step 10), increment iteration_count.\n\n**If iteration_count >= 3:**\n\nDisplay: `Max iterations reached. {N} issues remain:` + issue list\n\nOffer: 1) Force proceed, 2) Provide guidance and retry, 3) Abandon\n\n## 12.5. Plan Bounce (Optional External Refinement)\n\n**Skip if:** `--skip-bounce` flag, `--gaps` flag, or bounce is not activated.\n\n**Activation:** Bounce runs when `--bounce` flag is present OR `workflow.plan_bounce` config is `true`. The `--skip-bounce` flag always wins (disables bounce even if config enables it). The `--gaps` flag also disables bounce (gap-closure mode should not modify plans externally).\n\n**Prerequisites:** `workflow.plan_bounce_script` must be set to a valid script path. If bounce is activated but no script is configured, display warning and skip:\n```\n⚠ Plan bounce activated but no script configured.\nSet workflow.plan_bounce_script to the path of your refinement script.\nSkipping bounce step.\n```\n\n**Read pass count:**\n```bash\nBOUNCE_PASSES=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_passes 2>/dev/null || echo \"2\")\nBOUNCE_SCRIPT=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_script 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.' 2>/dev/null || true)\n```\n\nDisplay banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► BOUNCING PLANS (External Refinement)\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\nScript: ${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\nMax passes: ${BOUNCE_PASSES}\n```\n\n**For each PLAN.md file in the phase directory:**\n\n1. **Backup:** Copy `*-PLAN.md` to `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md`\n```bash\ncp \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${PLAN_FILE%.md}.pre-bounce.md\"\n```\n\n2. **Invoke bounce script:**\n```bash\n\"${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\" \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${BOUNCE_PASSES}\"\n```\n\n3. **Validate bounced plan — YAML frontmatter integrity:**\nAfter the script returns, check that the bounced file still has valid YAML frontmatter (opening and closing `---` delimiters with parseable content between them). If the bounced plan breaks YAML frontmatter validation, restore the original from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n```\n⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} has broken YAML frontmatter — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n4. **Handle script failure:** If the bounce script exits non-zero, restore the original plan from the pre-bounce.md backup and continue to the next plan:\n```\n⚠ Bounce script failed for ${PLAN_FILE} (exit code ${EXIT_CODE}) — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n**After all plans are bounced:**\n\n5. **Re-run plan checker on bounced plans:** Spawn gsd-plan-checker (same as step 10) on all modified plans. If a bounced plan fails the checker, restore original from its pre-bounce.md backup:\n```\n⚠ Bounced plan ${PLAN_FILE} failed checker validation — restoring original from pre-bounce backup.\n```\n\n6. **Commit surviving bounced plans:** If at least one plan survived both the frontmatter validation and the checker re-run, commit the changes:\n```bash\ngsd_run query commit \"refactor(${padded_phase}): bounce plans through external refinement\" --files \"${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md\"\n```\n\nDisplay summary:\n```\nPlan bounce complete: {survived}/{total} plans refined\n```\n\n**Clean up:** Remove all `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md` backup files after the bounce step completes (whether plans survived or were restored).\n\n## 13. Requirements Coverage Gate\n\nAfter plans pass the checker (or checker is skipped), verify that all phase requirements are covered by at least one plan.\n\n**Skip if:** `phase_req_ids` is null or TBD (no requirements mapped to this phase).\n\n**Step 1: Extract requirement IDs claimed by plans**\n```bash\n# Collect all requirement IDs from plan frontmatter\nPLAN_REQS=$(grep -h \"requirements_addressed\\|requirements:\" ${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u)\n```\n\n**Step 2: Compare against phase requirements from ROADMAP**\n\nFor each REQ-ID in `phase_req_ids`:\n- If REQ-ID appears in `PLAN_REQS` → covered ✓\n- If REQ-ID does NOT appear in any plan → uncovered ✗\n\n**Step 3: Check CONTEXT.md features against plan objectives**\n\nRead CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` section. Extract feature/capability names. Check each against plan `<objective>` blocks. Features not mentioned in any plan objective → potentially dropped.\n\n**Step 4: Report**\n\nIf all requirements covered and no dropped features:\n```\n✓ Requirements coverage: {N}/{N} REQ-IDs covered by plans\n```\n→ Proceed to step 14.\n\nIf gaps found:\n```\n## ⚠ Requirements Coverage Gap\n\n{M} of {N} phase requirements are not assigned to any plan:\n\n| REQ-ID | Description | Plans |\n|--------|-------------|-------|\n| {id} | {from REQUIREMENTS.md} | None |\n\n{K} CONTEXT.md features not found in plan objectives:\n- {feature_name} — described in CONTEXT.md but no plan covers it\n\nOptions:\n1. Re-plan to include missing requirements (recommended)\n2. Move uncovered requirements to next phase\n3. Proceed anyway — accept coverage gaps\n```\n\nIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list (options already shown in the block above). Otherwise use AskUserQuestion to present the options.\n\n## 13a. Decision Coverage Gate\n\nAfter the requirements coverage gate passes, verify that every trackable\ndecision captured by discuss-phase in CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` is referenced\nby at least one plan. This is the **translation gate** from issue #2492 —\nits job is to refuse to mark a phase planned when a discuss-phase decision\nsilently dropped on the way into the plans.\n\n**Skip if** `workflow.context_coverage_gate` is explicitly set to `false`\n(absent key = enabled). Also skip if no CONTEXT.md exists for this phase\n(nothing to translate) or if its `<decisions>` block is empty.\n\n```bash\nGATE_CFG=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.context_coverage_gate 2>/dev/null || echo \"true\")\nif [ \"$GATE_CFG\" != \"false\" ]; then\n  GATE_RESULT=$(gsd_run query check.decision-coverage-plan \"${PHASE_DIR}\" \"${CONTEXT_PATH}\")\n  # BLOCKING: refuse to mark phase planned when a trackable decision is uncovered.\n  # `passed: true` covers both real-pass and skipped cases (gate disabled / no CONTEXT.md /\n  # no trackable decisions). Verify-phase counterpart deliberately omits this exit-1 — that\n  # gate is non-blocking by design (review finding F15).\n  echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -e '(.passed // .data.passed) == true' >/dev/null || {\n    echo \"$GATE_RESULT\" | jq -r '(.message // .data.message // \"Decision coverage gate failed.\")'\n    exit 1\n  }\nfi\n```\n\nThe handler returns JSON:\n```json\n{\n  \"passed\": true,\n  \"skipped\": false,\n  \"total\":  2,\n  \"covered\": 2,\n  \"uncovered\": [ { \"id\": \"D-01\", \"text\": \"...\", \"category\": \"...\" } ],\n  \"message\": \"...\"\n}\n```\n\n**If `passed` is true (or `skipped` is true):** Display\n`✓ Decision coverage: {M}/{N} CONTEXT.md decisions covered by plans` (or\n`(skipped — gate disabled)` / `(skipped — no decisions)`) and proceed to\nstep 13b.\n\n**If `passed` is false:** Display the handler's `message` block. It already\nnames each uncovered decision (`D-NN | category | text`) and tells the user\nwhat to do — cite the id in a relevant plan's `must_haves` / `truths`, or\nmove the decision under `### Claude's Discretion` / tag it `[informational]`\nif it should not be tracked. Then offer:\n\n```text\nOptions:\n1. Re-plan to cover missing decisions (recommended)\n2. Edit CONTEXT.md to mark dropped decisions as [informational] / Discretion\n3. Proceed anyway — accept the coverage gap\n```\n\nIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list. Otherwise use\nAskUserQuestion. Selecting \"Proceed anyway\" continues to step 13b but\nrecords the override in STATE.md so verify-phase can re-surface it.\n\n**Why this gate blocks:** failing here is cheap. The plans are the contract\nbetween discuss-phase and execute-phase; if a decision isn't visible in any\nplan, no executor will implement it. Catching that now beats discovering it\nafter thousands of dollars of execution.\n\n## 13b. Record Planning Completion in STATE.md\n\nAfter plans pass all gates, record that planning is complete so STATE.md reflects the new phase status:\n\n```bash\ngsd_run query state.planned-phase --phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" --name \"${PHASE_NAME}\" --plans \"${PLAN_COUNT}\"\n```\n\nThis updates STATUS to \"Ready to execute\", sets the correct plan count, and timestamps Last Activity.\n\n## 13c. Annotate ROADMAP with Wave Dependencies and Cross-cutting Constraints\n\nAfter plans are finalized, annotate the ROADMAP.md plan list for this phase with:\n- **Wave dependency notes** — a bold header before each wave group (\"Wave 2 *(blocked on Wave 1 completion)*\")\n- **Cross-cutting constraints** — a \"Cross-cutting constraints:\" subsection listing `must_haves.truths` entries that appear in 2 or more plans\n\nThis step is derived entirely from existing PLAN frontmatter — no extra LLM pass is required.\n\n```bash\ngsd_run query roadmap.annotate-dependencies \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\"\n```\n\nThis operation is idempotent: if wave headers or cross-cutting constraints already exist in the ROADMAP phase section, the command returns without modifying the file. Skip this step if `plan_count` is 0.\n\n## 13d. Commit Plans if commit_docs is true\n\nIf `commit_docs` is true (from the init JSON parsed in step 1), commit the generated plan artifacts (including any ROADMAP.md annotations from step 13c):\n\n```bash\ngsd_run query commit \"docs(${PADDED_PHASE}): create phase plan\" --files \"${PHASE_DIR}\"/*-PLAN.md .planning/STATE.md .planning/ROADMAP.md\n```\n\nThis commits all PLAN.md files for the phase plus the updated STATE.md and ROADMAP.md to version-control the planning artifacts. Skip this step if `commit_docs` is false.\n\n## 13e. Post-Planning Gap Analysis (plan:post capability gate dispatch)\n\nProactive, non-blocking coverage report gated on `workflow.post_planning_gaps`\n(default `true`). Dispatched via the `plan:post` capability gate owned by the\n`gap-analysis` capability (ADR-857 §53). Reads REQUIREMENTS.md and CONTEXT.md\n`<decisions>` and cross-references each REQ-ID / D-ID against `${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md`.\n\n```bash\nPLAN_POST_HOOKS_JSON=$(gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:post --raw)\nPHASE_REQ_IDS=$(gsd_run query init.plan-phase \"$PHASE\" --pick phase_req_ids 2>/dev/null || echo TBD)\n```\n\nRead the `activeHooks` array from `PLAN_POST_HOOKS_JSON` in-context. If the\n`gap-analysis` gate hook is absent (capability inactive), skip this step.\n\n**For each active entry where `kind == \"gate\"`** (process in array order):\n\n```bash\nGATE_RESULT=$(gsd_run check ${hook.check.query} \"${PHASE_DIR}\" \"${PHASE_REQ_IDS}\" --raw)\nCHECK_EXIT=$?\n```\n\n**Step 1 — did the CHECK COMMAND itself succeed?**\nIf the check command failed (non-zero `CHECK_EXIT`, empty output, or unparseable JSON):\n- `onError == \"halt\"` → halt and surface command error.\n- `onError == \"skip\"` → log a warning and continue to the next hook.\n\n**Step 2 — read `GATE_RESULT.block` (boolean).** Only reached when command succeeded.\n\n- If `hook.blocking == true` and `GATE_RESULT.block == true`: halt. (gap-analysis is always `blocking: false` so this branch is informational only.)\n- If `hook.blocking == false` (advisory): if `GATE_RESULT.block == true` or non-empty `table`/`summary`, output the gap table and continue. Advisory gates never block phase completion.\n- If `hook.blocking == true` and `GATE_RESULT.block == false`: continue silently.\n\n## 14. Present Final Status\n\nRoute to `<offer_next>` OR `auto_advance` depending on flags/config.\n\n## 15. Auto-Advance Check\n\nCheck for auto-advance trigger using values already loaded in step 1:\n\n1. Parse `--auto` and `--chain` flags from $ARGUMENTS\n2. Use `auto_chain_active` and `auto_advance` from the INIT JSON parsed in step 1 — **do not issue additional `config-get` calls for these values** (they are already present in the init output). Issuing redundant `config-get` calls for values already in INIT can cause infinite read loops on some runtimes.\n3. **Sync chain flag with intent** — if user invoked manually (no `--auto` and no `--chain`), clear the ephemeral chain flag from any previous interrupted `--auto` chain. This does NOT touch `workflow.auto_advance` (the user's persistent settings preference):\n   ```bash\n   if [[ ! \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --auto ]] && [[ ! \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --chain ]]; then\n     gsd_run query config-set workflow._auto_chain_active false || true\n   fi\n   ```\n\nSet local variables from INIT (parsed once in step 1):\n- `AUTO_CHAIN` = `auto_chain_active` from INIT JSON (boolean, default false)\n- `AUTO_CFG` = `auto_advance` from INIT JSON (boolean, default false)\n\n**If `--auto` or `--chain` flag present AND `AUTO_CHAIN` is not true:** Persist chain flag to config (handles direct invocation without prior discuss-phase):\n```bash\nif ([[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --auto ]] || [[ \"$ARGUMENTS\" =~ --chain ]]) && [[ \"$AUTO_CHAIN\" != \"true\" ]]; then\n  gsd_run query config-set workflow._auto_chain_active true\nfi\n```\n\n**If `--auto` or `--chain` flag present OR `AUTO_CHAIN` is true OR `AUTO_CFG` is true:**\n\nDisplay banner:\n```\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n GSD ► AUTO-ADVANCING TO EXECUTE\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\nPlans ready. Security Threat Model Gate\n407\t\n408\t> Capability-driven dispatch. Resolves active `plan:pre` hooks via the capability registry; each hook's `when` condition is evaluated by the registry — no inline config-get needed. This section handles skill-based planning preflights such as `ai-integration`, agent-backed hooks through `ref.agent`, and the UI gate whose deterministic check comes from `check.query`.\n437\t>\n438\t> **Config semantics (cutover fix):** `workflow.ui_phase` gates UI-SPEC *generation* (step); `workflow.ui_safety_gate` gates the *planning block* (gate). Both-on = identical to OLD §5.6. Intended change: `{ui_phase:true, ui_safety_gate:false}` now auto-generates in pipelines but does NOT block manual planning (each key controls exactly what its description says).\n439\t\n440\t```bash\n441\tPLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON=${PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON:-$(gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw)}\n442\tHOOKS_JSON=\"$PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON\"\n443\t```\n444\t\n445\tRead the `activeHooks` array directly from `PLAN_PRE_HOOKS_JSON` / `HOOKS_JSON` (in-context — do NOT invoke a shell pipeline).\n446\t\n447\t**Branch 1 — all plan:pre hooks inactive (`activeHooks` is empty or absent):** Skip to step 6.\n448\t\n449\t**Generic step hook dispatch contract:** For each active entry where `kind == \"step\"`:\n450\t- If `ref.skill` is set, dispatch with `Skill(skill=\"gsd-${ref.skill}\", args=\"${PHASE} --auto ${GSD_WS}\")` when pipeline mode allows auto-chaining. Use a flat scalar `verification:` continuation key, never a nested object (ADR-550 #1278). At verify time a `backstop` truth the verifier cannot confirm with explicit evidence abstains → `human_needed` (reason `insufficient_spec`), never a silent pass (#1154; see `gsd-core/references/honest-verifier.md`). `unresolved` edges are explicit assumptions — surface them in the plan, do not silently drop them. **Otherwise** (`EDGE_ABSENT`): apply the SAME lift to the fallback report `{COVERAGE}` (per §C of `gsd-core/references/specless-probe-fallback.md`); a SPEC-supplied section is never re-run.\n778\t- If the SPEC has a `## Prohibitions` section, lift every resolved prohibition into the `must_haves.prohibitions:` sibling block (NOT `truths` — ADR-550 D3) with `statement`+`status`+`verification`, via the single `projectProhibitions` serializer (Hyrum — no second serializer); unresolved -> flagged assumptions, don't drop; never put a must-NOT under `truths`. **Otherwise** (`PROHIB_ABSENT`), author the recalled prohibitions into the SAME block via the SAME `projectProhibitions` contract but **descriptor-less** (no `check_*`) so each disposes flagged-unverified; never auto-dismiss. Rules:\n794\t   - Every criterion must be checkable as a source assertion, behavior assertion, test command, or CLI output\n795\t   - NEVER use subjective language (\"looks correct\", \"properly configured\", \"consistent with\")\n796\t   - Include exact strings, patterns, values, command outputs, or observable behavior where that is the right proof\n797\t   - Examples:\n798\t     - Code: `auth.py contains def verify_token(` / `test_auth.py exits 0`\n799\t     - Behavior: `POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + httpOnly JWT cookie for valid credentials`\n800\t     - Config: `.env.example contains DATABASE_URL=` / `Dockerfile contains HEALTHCHECK`\n801\t     - Docs: `README.md contains '## Installation'` / `API.md lists all endpoints`\n802\t     - Infra: `deploy.yml has rollback step` / `docker-compose.yml has healthcheck for db`\n803\t\n804\t3. **`<action>`** — Must include CONCRETE values, not references. Rules:\n805\t   - NEVER say \"align X with Y\", \"match X to Y\", \"update to be consistent\" without specifying the exact target state\n806\t   - Include concrete identifiers and reference values: config keys, function signatures, SQL table names, class names, import paths, env vars, endpoint paths, etc.\n807\t   - If CONTEXT.md has a comparison table or expected values, copy only the target identifiers/values needed to remove ambiguity\n808\t   - Do not include full file contents, fenced code blocks, or complete implementations in `<action>`\n809\t   - The executor should understand the intended target state from `<action>` and use `<read_first>` files for current implementation details, patterns, and source-of-truth context\n810\t\n811\t**Why this matters:** Executor agents work from the plan text. Vague instructions like \"update the config to match production\" produce shallow one-line changes. Concrete instructions like \"add DATABASE_URL, set POOL_SIZE=20, add REDIS_URL, and read config/runtime.ts before editing\" produce complete work without turning the planner into the executor.\n812\t</deep_work_rules>\n813\t\n814\t<quality_gate>\n815\t- [ ] PLAN.md files created in phase directory\n816\t- [ ] Each plan has valid frontmatter\n817\t- [ ] Tasks are specific and actionable\n818\t- [ ] Every task has `<read_first>` with at least the file being modified\n819\t- [ ] Every task has `<acceptance_criteria>` with behavior, test-command, CLI, or source assertions\n820\t- [ ] Every `<action>` contains concrete identifiers without fenced code blocks or full implementations\n821\t- [ ] Dependencies correctly identified\n822\t- [ ] Waves assigned for parallel execution\n823\t- [ ] must_haves derived from phase goal\n824\t- [ ] Every PLAN.md includes an \"Artifacts this phase produces\" section listing symbols created by this phase (decorators, classes, functions, CLI flags, struct/dataclass fields, new file paths)\n825\t- [ ] Every SPEC ## Edge Coverage resolved edge is represented in a plan's must_haves (no silent drops)\n826\t- [ ] Every UI-SPEC ## UI Considerations resolved consideration is represented in a plan's must_haves (no silent drops)\n827\t- [ ] Every SPEC ## Prohibitions resolved item is represented in a plan's must_haves.prohibitions (no silent drops)\n828\t</quality_gate>\n829\t```\n830\t\n831\t**If `CHUNKED_MODE` is `false` (default):** Spawn the planner as a single long-lived Agent:\n832\t\n833\t```text\n834\tAgent(\n835\t  prompt=filled_prompt,\n836\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n837\t  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n838\t  description=\"Plan Phase {phase}\",\n839\t  run_in_background=true\n840\t)\n841\t```\n842\t\n843\t**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** `TS=$(date +%s)`; Handle in step 9b.\n853\t- **`## ⚠ Source Audit: Unplanned Items Found`:** The planner's multi-source coverage audit found items from REQUIREMENTS.md, RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP goal, or CONTEXT.md decisions that are not covered by any plan. Filesystem Fallback (Planner)\n859\t\n860\t**Triggered when:** Agent() returns but the return contains no recognized marker (`## PLANNING COMPLETE`, `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, `## ⚠ Source Audit`, `## CHECKPOINT REACHED`, `## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE`).\n861\t\n862\t```bash\n863\t# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n864\t# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n865\t# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n866\t# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n867\t# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\n868\tDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n869\t```\n870\t\n871\t**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** The planner wrote plans to disk but the Agent() return was empty or\n872\ttruncated (the Windows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never\n873\tarrived). Display:\n874\t\n875\t```text\n876\t◆ Planner wrote {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) to disk but did not emit a PLANNING COMPLETE marker.\n877\t  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — work is likely recoverable.\n878\t\n879\t  Plans found on disk:\n880\t  {ls output of *-PLAN.md}\n881\t```\n882\t\n883\tOffer 3 options:\n884\t1. **Accept plans** — treat as `## PLANNING COMPLETE` and continue through step 9 `## PLANNING COMPLETE` handling (so `--skip-verify` / `plan_checker_enabled=false` are honored — may skip to step 13 rather than step 10)\n885\t2. **Retry planner** — re-spawn the planner with the same prompt (return to step 8)\n886\t3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n887\t\n888\t**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0 and no marker:** The planner produced no output. Treat as\n889\t`## PLANNING INCONCLUSIVE` and handle accordingly.\n890\t\n891\t## 9b. Handle Phase Split Recommendation\n892\t\n893\tWhen the planner returns `## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED`, it means the phase's source items exceed the context budget for full-fidelity implementation. The planner proposes groupings.\n894\t\n895\t**Extract from planner return:**\n896\t- Proposed sub-phases (e.g., \"17a: processing core (D-01 to D-19)\", \"17b: billing + config UX (D-20 to D-27)\")\n897\t- Which source items (REQ-IDs, D-XX decisions, RESEARCH items) go in each sub-phase\n898\t- Why the split is necessary (context cost estimate, file count)\n899\t\n900\t**Present to user:**\n901\t```\n902\t## Phase {X} exceeds context budget for full-fidelity implementation\n903\t\n904\tThe planner found {N} source items that exceed the context budget when\n905\tplanned at full fidelity. Instead of reducing scope, we recommend splitting:\n906\t\n907\t**Option 1: Split into sub-phases**\n908\t- Phase {X}a: {name} — {items} ({N} source items, ~{P}% context)\n909\t- Phase {X}b: {name} — {items} ({M} source items, ~{Q}% context)\n910\t\n911\t**Option 2: Proceed anyway** (planner will attempt all, quality may degrade past 50% context)\n912\t\n913\t**Option 3: Prioritize** — you choose which items to implement now,\n914\trest become a follow-up phase\n915\t```\n916\t\n917\tUse AskUserQuestion with these 3 options.\n918\t\n919\t**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` to create the sub-phases, then replan each.\n920\t**If \"Proceed\":** Return to planner with instruction to attempt all items at full fidelity, accepting more plans/tasks.\n921\t**If \"Prioritize\":** Use AskUserQuestion (multiSelect) to let user pick which items are \"now\" vs \"later\". Create CONTEXT.md for each sub-phase with the selected items.\n922\t\n923\t## 9c. Handle Source Audit Gaps\n924\t\n925\tWhen the planner returns `## ⚠ Source Audit: Unplanned Items Found`, it means items from REQUIREMENTS.md, RESEARCH.md, ROADMAP goal, or CONTEXT.md decisions have no corresponding plan.\n926\t\n927\t**Extract from planner return:**\n928\t- Each unplanned item with its source artifact and section\n929\t- The planner's suggested options (A: add plan, B: split phase, C: defer with confirmation)\n930\t\n931\t**Present each gap to user.** For each unplanned item:\n932\t\n933\t```\n934\t## ⚠ Unplanned: {item description}\n935\t\n936\tSource: {RESEARCH.md / REQUIREMENTS.md / ROADMAP goal / CONTEXT.md}\n937\tDetails: {why the planner flagged this}\n938\t\n939\tOptions:\n940\t1. Defer — add to backlog (developer confirms this is intentional)\n943\t```\n944\t\n945\tUse AskUserQuestion for each gap (or batch if multiple gaps).\n946\t\n947\t**If \"Add plan\":** Return to planner (step 8) with instruction to add plans covering the missing items, preserving existing plans.\n948\t**If \"Split\":** Use `/gsd-phase --insert` for overflow items, then replan.\n949\t**If \"Defer\":** Record in CONTEXT.md `## Deferred Ideas` with developer's confirmation. Proceed to step 10.\n950\t\n951\t## 10. Spawn gsd-plan-checker Agent\n952\t\n953\tDisplay banner:\n954\t```\n955\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n956\t GSD ► VERIFYING PLANS\n957\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n958\t\n959\t◆ Spawning plan checker... (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)\n960\t```\n961\t\n962\tChecker prompt:\n963\t\n964\t```markdown\n965\t<verification_context>\n966\t**Phase:** {phase_number}\n967\t**Phase Goal:** {goal from ROADMAP}\n968\t**Mode:** {standard | gap_closure | reviews}\n969\t\n970\t<required_reading>\n971\t- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Plans to verify)\n972\t- {roadmap_path} (Roadmap)\n973\t- {requirements_path} (Requirements)\n974\t- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n975\t- {research_path} (Technical Research — includes Validation Architecture)\n976\t- {reviews_path} (Cross-AI Review Feedback - if --reviews; verify actionable findings are represented in PLAN.md)\n977\t</required_reading>\n978\t\n979\t${AGENT_SKILLS_CHECKER}\n980\t\n981\t<review_incorporation_verification>\n982\t**If Mode is reviews:** Read REVIEWS.md and verify each current actionable review finding is visible in executable PLAN.md content or explicitly deferred/rejected in the relevant PLAN.md. Use WARNING by default; use BLOCKER when the missing incorporation can prevent the phase goal, create unsafe execution, or invalidate verification.\n985\t</review_incorporation_verification>\n986\t\n987\t**Phase requirement IDs (MUST ALL be covered):** {phase_req_ids}\n988\t\n989\t**Project instructions:** Read ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md if either exists — verify plans honor project guidelines\n990\t**Project skills:** Check .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/ directory (if either exists) — verify plans account for project skill rules\n991\t</verification_context>\n992\t\n993\t<expected_output>\n994\t- ## VERIFICATION PASSED — all checks pass\n995\t- ## ISSUES FOUND — structured issue list\n996\t</expected_output>\n997\t```\n998\t\n999\t```\n1000\tAgent(\n1001\t  prompt=checker_prompt,\n1002\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-plan-checker\",\n1003\t  model=\"{checker_model}\",\n1004\t  description=\"Verify Phase {phase} plans\",\n1005\t  run_in_background=true\n1006\t)\n1007\t```\n1008\t\n1009\t**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `CHECKER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md' \"## VERIFICATION PASSED\" \"## ISSUES FOUND\")` while waiting/active.\n1010\t\n1011\t## 11. Handle Checker Return\n1012\t\n1013\t- **`marker_received` + `## VERIFICATION PASSED`:** Display confirmation, proceed to step 13.\n1014\t- **`marker_received` + `## ISSUES FOUND`:** Display issues, check iteration count, proceed to step 12.\n1015\t- **`stalled`:** Automatically surface 11a's recovery choice (Accept verification / Retry checker / Stop) — no manual interrupt needed.\n1016\t- **Empty / truncated / no recognized marker:** → Filesystem fallback (step 11a).\n1017\t\n1018\t**Thinking partner for architectural tradeoffs (conditional):**\n1019\tIf `features.thinking_partner` is enabled, scan the checker's issues for architectural tradeoff keywords\n1020\t(\"architecture\", \"approach\", \"strategy\", \"pattern\", \"vs\", \"alternative\"). Filesystem Fallback (Checker)\n1038\t\n1039\t**Triggered when:** Checker Agent() returns but the return contains neither `## VERIFICATION PASSED` nor `## ISSUES FOUND`.\n1040\t\n1041\t```bash\n1042\t# #3218: this asks \"did the planner write files to disk at all\" — a\n1043\t# planner-produced-nothing check, not outstanding-work counting — so it\n1044\t# takes the PHYSICAL set (`plan_count_all`, status:superseded INCLUDED): a\n1045\t# superseded plan is still a file the planner wrote, and this check must not\n1046\t# read \"nothing written\" just because every plan happens to be superseded.\n1047\tDISK_PLANS=$(gsd_run query find-phase \"${PHASE_NUMBER}\" | jq -r '.plan_count_all // 0')\n1048\t```\n1049\t\n1050\t**If `DISK_PLANS` > 0:** Plans exist on disk; the checker return was empty or truncated (the\n1051\tWindows stdio hang pattern — the subagent finished but the return never arrived). Display:\n1052\t\n1053\t```text\n1054\t◆ Checker return was empty or truncated. {DISK_PLANS} plan(s) exist on disk.\n1055\t  This is a known Windows stdio hang pattern — checker may have completed without returning.\n1056\t```\n1057\t\n1058\tOffer 3 options:\n1059\t1. **Accept verification** — treat as `## VERIFICATION PASSED` and continue to step 13\n1060\t2. **Retry checker** — re-spawn the checker with the same prompt (return to step 10)\n1061\t3. **Stop** — exit; user can re-run `/gsd-plan-phase {N}` to resume\n1062\t\n1063\t**If `DISK_PLANS` is 0:** No plans on disk — something is seriously wrong. Display error and stop.\n1064\t\n1065\t## 12. Revision Loop (Max 3 Iterations)\n1066\t\n1067\tTrack `iteration_count` (starts at 1 after initial plan + check).\n1068\tTrack `prev_issue_count` (initialized to `Infinity` before the loop begins).\n1069\tTrack `stall_reentry_count` (starts at 0; incremented each time \"Adjust approach\" re-enters step 8).\n1070\t\n1071\t**If iteration_count < 3:**\n1072\t\n1073\tParse issue count from checker return: count BLOCKER + WARNING entries in the YAML issues block (structured output from gsd-plan-checker). If the checker's return contains no YAML issues block (i.e., the plan was approved with no issues), treat `issue_count` as 0 and skip the stall check — the plan passed. Proceed to step 13.\n1074\t\n1075\tDisplay: `Revision iteration {N}/3 -- {blocker_count} blockers, {warning_count} warnings`\n1076\t\n1077\t**Stall detection:** If `issue_count >= prev_issue_count`:\n1078\t  Display: `Revision loop stalled — issue count not decreasing ({issue_count} issues remain after {N} iterations)`\n1079\t\n1080\t  **If `stall_reentry_count < 2`:**\n1081\t    Ask user:\n1082\t      Question: \"Issues remain after {N} revision attempts with no progress. Proceed with current output?\"\n1083\t      Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Adjust approach\"\n1084\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1085\t    If \"Adjust approach\": increment `stall_reentry_count`, open freeform discussion, then re-enter step 8 (full replanning). Note: re-entry resets `iteration_count` and `prev_issue_count` but `stall_reentry_count` persists across re-entries and is capped at 2.\n1086\t\n1087\t  **If `stall_reentry_count >= 2`:**\n1088\t    Display: `Stall persists after 2 re-planning attempts. The following issues could not be resolved automatically:`\n1089\t    List the remaining issues from the checker.\n1090\t    Suggest: \"Consider resolving these issues manually or running `/gsd-debug` to investigate root causes.\"\n1091\t    Options: \"Proceed anyway\" | \"Abandon\"\n1092\t    If \"Proceed anyway\": accept current plans and continue to step 13.\n1093\t    If \"Abandon\": stop workflow.\n1094\t\n1095\tSet `prev_issue_count = issue_count`.\n1096\t\n1097\tRevision prompt:\n1098\t\n1099\t```markdown\n1100\t<revision_context>\n1101\t**Phase:** {phase_number}\n1102\t**Mode:** revision\n1103\t\n1104\t<required_reading>\n1105\t- {PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md (Existing plans)\n1106\t- {context_path} (USER DECISIONS from /gsd-discuss-phase)\n1107\t</required_reading>\n1108\t\n1109\t${AGENT_SKILLS_PLANNER}\n1110\t\n1111\t**Checker issues:** {structured_issues_from_checker}\n1112\t</revision_context>\n1113\t\n1114\t<instructions>\n1115\tMake targeted updates to address checker issues.\n1116\tDo NOT replan from scratch unless issues are fundamental.\n1117\tReturn what changed.\n1118\t</instructions>\n1119\t```\n1120\t\n1121\t```\n1122\tAgent(\n1123\t  prompt=revision_prompt,\n1124\t  subagent_type=\"gsd-planner\",\n1125\t  model=\"{planner_model}\",\n1126\t  description=\"Revise Phase {phase} plans\",\n1127\t  run_in_background=true\n1128\t)\n1129\t```\n1130\t\n1131\t**ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES:** (7.99; no marker, mtimes only) `TS=$(date +%s)`; repeat `PLANNER_STALL_RESULT=$(gsd_stall_watch \"$TS\" \"{outputFile}\" \"${PHASE_DIR}\"'/*-PLAN.md')` while waiting/active — `stalled` -> 1) Accept as revised, to step 13, 2) Retry, 3) Stop.\n1132\t\n1133\tAfter planner returns -> spawn checker again (step 10), increment iteration_count.\n1134\t\n1135\t**If iteration_count >= 3:**\n1136\t\n1137\tDisplay: `Max iterations reached. {N} issues remain:` + issue list\n1138\t\n1139\tOffer: 1) Force proceed, 2) Provide guidance and retry, 3) Abandon\n1140\t\n1141\t## 12.5. Plan Bounce (Optional External Refinement)\n1142\t\n1143\t**Skip if:** `--skip-bounce` flag, `--gaps` flag, or bounce is not activated.\n1144\t\n1145\t**Activation:** Bounce runs when `--bounce` flag is present OR `workflow.plan_bounce` config is `true`. The `--skip-bounce` flag always wins (disables bounce even if config enables it). The `--gaps` flag also disables bounce (gap-closure mode should not modify plans externally).\n1146\t\n1147\t**Prerequisites:** `workflow.plan_bounce_script` must be set to a valid script path. If bounce is activated but no script is configured, display warning and skip:\n1148\t```\n1149\t⚠ Plan bounce activated but no script configured.\n1150\tSet workflow.plan_bounce_script to the path of your refinement script.\n1151\tSkipping bounce step.\n1152\t```\n1153\t\n1154\t**Read pass count:**\n1155\t```bash\n1156\tBOUNCE_PASSES=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_passes 2>/dev/null || echo \"2\")\n1157\tBOUNCE_SCRIPT=$(gsd_run query config-get workflow.plan_bounce_script --raw 2>/dev/null || true)\n1158\t```\n1159\t\n1160\tDisplay banner:\n1161\t```\n1162\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1163\t GSD ► BOUNCING PLANS (External Refinement)\n1164\t━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n1165\t\n1166\tScript: ${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\n1167\tMax passes: ${BOUNCE_PASSES}\n1168\t```\n1169\t\n1170\t**For each PLAN.md file in the phase directory:**\n1171\t\n1172\t1. **Backup:** Copy `*-PLAN.md` to `*-PLAN.pre-bounce.md`\n1173\t```bash\n1174\tcp \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${PLAN_FILE%.md}.pre-bounce.md\"\n1175\t```\n1176\t\n1177\t2. **Invoke bounce script:**\n1178\t```bash\n1179\t\"${BOUNCE_SCRIPT}\" \"${PLAN_FILE}\" \"${BOUNCE_PASSES}\"\n1180\t```\n1181\t\n1182\t3. **Validate bounced plan — YAML frontmatter integrity:**\n1183\tAfter the script returns, check that the bounced file still has valid YAML frontmatter (opening and closing `---` delimiters with parseable content between them). Requirements Coverage Gate\n1213\t\n1214\tAfter plans pass the checker (or checker is skipped), verify that all phase requirements are covered by at least one plan.\n1215\t\n1216\t**Skip if:** `phase_req_ids` is null or TBD (no requirements mapped to this phase).\n1217\t\n1218\t**Step 1: Extract requirement IDs claimed by plans**\n1219\t```bash\n1220\t# Collect all requirement IDs from plan frontmatter\n1221\tPLAN_REQS=$(grep -h \"requirements_addressed\\|requirements:\" ${PHASE_DIR}/*-PLAN.md 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u)\n1222\t```\n1223\t\n1224\t**Step 2: Compare against phase requirements from ROADMAP**\n1225\t\n1226\tFor each REQ-ID in `phase_req_ids`:\n1227\t- If REQ-ID appears in `PLAN_REQS` → covered ✓\n1228\t- If REQ-ID does NOT appear in any plan → uncovered ✗\n1229\t\n1230\t**Step 3: Check CONTEXT.md features against plan objectives**\n1231\t\n1232\tRead CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` section. Proceed anyway — accept coverage gaps\n1259\t```\n1260\t\n1261\tIf `TEXT_MODE` is true, present as a plain-text numbered list (options already shown in the block above). Otherwise use AskUserQuestion to present the options.\n1262\t\n1263\t## 13a. Decision Coverage Gate\n1264\t\n1265\tVerify every trackable decision in CONTEXT.md `<decisions>` is referenced by at\n1266\tleast one plan. Parse and Normalize Arguments\n\nExtract from $ARGUMENTS: phase number (integer or decimal like `2.1`), flags (`--research`, `--skip-research`, `--research-phase <N>`, `--gaps`, `--skip-verify`, `--skip-ui`, `--prd <filepath>`, `--ingest <path-or-glob>`, `--ingest-format <auto|nygard|madr|narrative>`, `--reviews`, `--text`, `--bounce`, `--skip-bounce`, `--chunked`, `--mvp`, `--no-tracer`, `--no-reversibility-gates`, `--tdd`, `--granularity <coarse|standard|fine>`, `--force` (override closed-phase gate, see §1.5)).\n\n**`--research-phase <N>` — research-only mode (#3042 + #3044).** When this flag is present, parse `<N>` as the phase number (overrides any positional phase argument), set `RESEARCH_ONLY=true`, and treat the rest of this workflow as a research-dispatch only — the planner spawn (step 8), plan-checker, verification, gaps, bounce, and post-planning-gaps blocks all skip on `RESEARCH_ONLY`. Replaces the deleted `/gsd-research-phase` command.\n\nIn research-only mode, two modifiers control behavior when `RESEARCH.md` already exists:\n\n- **`--research`** — force-refresh re-research without prompting. Re-spawns the researcher unconditionally and overwrites the existing RESEARCH.md.
